drawn.title: Investment Banking Associate, Healthcare
drawn.body:
Solutions for Today’s Challenges. Vision for Tomorrow’s Opportunities.

Join William Blair, the Premier Global Partnership.

William Blair is a premier global investment bank providing independent strategic and financial advice to companies, investors and institutions worldwide. Our Healthcare Investment Banking team advises leading healthcare companies across healthcare services, life sciences, medical technology, diagnostics, healthcare technology and outsourced pharmaceutical services sectors.

We partner with founders, management teams, boards of directors and financial sponsors to provide innovative solutions across mergers and acquisitions, private capital raises and strategic advisory engagements. Associates play an integral role in transaction execution, business development and team leadership while working alongside senior bankers and industry leaders in a demanding, yet collegiate way.

As a member of the Healthcare Group, you will gain significant exposure to companies and investors driving innovation, improving patient outcomes and advancing healthcare delivery globally.

Why William Blair

At William Blair, Associates are empowered to make meaningful contributions from their first day. Our entrepreneurial culture, collaborative environment and commitment to professional development provides an exceptional platform for building a successful career in investment banking.

What differentiates William Blair:

  • Significant responsibility and ownership on live transactions.
  • Direct exposure to senior bankers, healthcare executives, founders and private equity investors.
  • Broad transaction experience across mergers and acquisitions, capital raising and strategic advisory engagements.
  • An employee-owned partnership culture focused on collaboration, integrity and long-term client relationships.
  • Extensive mentorship, leadership development and professional growth opportunities.
  • Deep sector expertise across healthcare services, life sciences and healthcare innovation.
  • A collaborative environment that encourages intellectual curiosity, initiative and entrepreneurial thinking.

Position Overview

As an Investment Banking Associate within the Healthcare Group, you will play a central role in supporting and executing client engagements while helping manage day-to-day transaction processes.

You will oversee financial analyses, coordinate diligence efforts, manage Analysts, develop client-facing materials and contribute directly to strategic recommendations for clients and prospects. The role requires strong technical capabilities, commercial judgement, project management skills and an interest in the evolving healthcare landscape.

Successful candidates will possess advanced financial modelling expertise, strong attention to detail and the ability to lead multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Transaction Execution

  • Lead execution workstreams for mergers and acquisitions, private capital raising transactions and strategic advisory assignments.
  • Develop, review and oversee complex financial models, including operating models, merger models, leveraged buyout analyses and valuation models.
  • Apply and oversee core valuation methodologies, including comparable company analysis, precedent transactions and discounted cash flow analysis.
  • Coordinate financial, operational and commercial due diligence processes.
  • Manage interactions with clients, investors, legal advisers and other transaction participants throughout deal execution.
  • Evaluate company performance, strategic positioning, growth opportunities and transaction risks.
  • Support senior bankers in developing transaction strategies, transaction positioning and client recommendations.
  • Review transaction materials and ensure the accuracy and quality of analytical deliverables.

Healthcare Sector Expertise

  • Develop deep expertise across healthcare services, life sciences, medical technology, diagnostics, healthcare IT, pharmaceutical services and related sectors.
  • Analyse healthcare market trends, regulatory developments, reimbursement dynamics and competitive landscapes.
  • Monitor public and private healthcare market activity, financing trends, valuation developments and M&A transactions.
  • Evaluate healthcare-specific operating metrics, growth drivers, utilisation trends and profitability indicators.
  • Conduct strategic market research to support client coverage initiatives and business development efforts.
  • Track emerging healthcare trends and innovations influencing investment and acquisition activity.

Client Relationship Management

  • Prepare, review and present client-facing materials, including pitch books, confidential information memoranda, management presentations and board materials.
  • Participate in client meetings, management presentations and transaction discussions.
  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for clients, investors and transaction counterparties.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client objectives, strategic priorities and sector dynamics.
  • Provide responsive, thoughtful and high-quality client service throughout the transaction process.
  • Support relationship development efforts with private equity sponsors, strategic acquirers and healthcare executives.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Manage and mentor Analysts, providing coaching, guidance and constructive feedback.
  • Review financial analyses, valuation work and presentation materials prepared by junior team members.
  • Support the training and development of incoming Analysts and Summer Interns.
  • Assist with recruiting and broader team development initiatives.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performance team environment.

Business Development

  • Support origination and business development efforts across the Healthcare sector.
  • Prepare strategic marketing materials and presentations for prospective clients.
  • Identify emerging healthcare themes, industry trends and potential transaction opportunities.
  • Analyse market developments, investor activity and strategic priorities across healthcare subsectors.
  • Contribute to thought leadership, sector insights and relationship-building initiatives.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Ensure all activities comply with applicable regulations, firm policies and professional standards.
  • Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy and integrity.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record.
  • Previous experience of investment banking, corporate finance, transaction advisory, valuation, consulting or related experience.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or executing M&A, capital raising or strategic advisory transactions.
  • Strong understanding of accounting, corporate finance, valuation methodologies and financial statement analysis.
  • Advanced financial modelling and analytical capabilities.
  • Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong project management and organisational abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated leadership potential and commitment to mentoring junior professionals.
  • Strong interest in healthcare, healthcare innovation and the businesses shaping the future of the industry.

Preferred

  • Prior experience within investment banking or transaction advisory.
  • Experience covering healthcare services, healthcare IT, life sciences, medical technology, pharmaceuticals or related sectors.
  • Experience interacting directly with clients, management teams, sponsors and senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage Analysts and review complex analytical work products.
  • Exposure to sponsor-backed, founder-led or growth-oriented healthcare companies.

William Blair strives to attract qualified candidates who specialize in investment banking, investment management, private wealth management, and other strategic resource groups. We are committed to empowering our colleagues to deliver client success and engage in our communities. Our firm has delivered trusted advice for nine decades, continuing to deepen our expertise and relationships across asset classes and markets throughout North America, Europe, and Asia. drawn.title: Commercial Credit Analyst-Broadly Syndicated Lending
drawn.body: Commercial Credit Analyst-Broadly Syndicated Lending Location US-MO-Saint Louis ID 2026-10042 Category Banking & Lending Position Type Regular | Full Time Work Type Onsite Why Stifel Stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole. Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success . What You'll Be Doing The Credit Analyst will provide support to the Commercial Lenders and Portfolio Managers with emphasis on financial analysis in determining the creditworthiness of a borrower. The Credit Analyst will have exposure to both private and public companies over a wide variety of industries, cash flow and other types of lending, and direct and syndicated loan opportunities. What We're Looking For Analyze business financial statements and create cash flow models to be utilized in support of new and existing commercial loans, renewal requests, and amendments. Assist in the preparation of credit evaluation memorandums, annual and quarterly reviews, and accurate and timely risk ratings. Assist in the ongoing management and monitoring of a commercial loan portfolio. Ensure that certain financial statements and compliance certificates are up-to-date. Maintain in-depth knowledge of the soundness of borrowers and collateral through financial research, including evaluating financial statements and analyzing third party data. Assist in preparation of monthly Bank Board of Directors reports providing a summary of commercial relationships. May assist with overarching Corporate Banking projects. What You'll Bring Self-motivated with strong work ethic. Strong ability to effectively communicate (written and oral). Knowledge of economic and accounting principles and practices, the financial markets, banking and the analysis and reporting of financial data. drawn.title: Junior Compliance Officer
drawn.body:
Madrid, Spain | Full-time
Reports to: Head of Legal & Compliance
About Blue Earth Capital
Blue Earth Capital is a global, independent specialist impact investment firm headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with team members based in London, New York, Madrid and Konstanz. With approximately USD 1.9 billion in assets under management, we invest across Private Equity, Private Credit and Private Equity Partnerships, seeking measurable environmental and social impact alongside attractive, market-rate financial returns.
BlueEarth is owned by the Blue Earth Foundation, a Swiss charitable foundation that uses the firm’s profits to support philanthropic initiatives.
The role
Blue Earth Capital is creating a Junior Compliance Officer position based in Madrid to strengthen the Legal & Compliance team's global compliance capacity. Reporting to the Head of Legal & Compliance, the initial priority is managing the day-to-day AML/KYC/KYA processes across the firm's funds and entities. The role also supports the issuance and supervision of compliance policies and manuals and the development and operation of a firm-wide compliance monitoring program, under senior guidance. The role prepares reviews, documents findings and escalates exceptions; final approvals remain with the designated senior approver. This is a hands-on role for a candidate building a career in compliance within the impact and private markets industry.
Key responsibilities

• Global AML/KYC management: Manage AML/KYC/KYA due diligence for the firm's funds and entities, including onboarding, periodic and event-driven reviews. Collect and review documentation, identify gaps or risk indicators, document findings and escalate exceptions in line with internal procedures. Coordinate with our global investment teams and external counterparties to keep documentation complete and current.

• Transaction & fund support: Assist investment teams with KYC/AML documentation and process requirements during deal execution, closings, and ongoing fund/entity maintenance.

• Directives & manuals: Help draft, review and update the firm's compliance directives, policies and manuals under senior guidance, incorporating agreed regulatory and internal requirements; maintain version control and the policy library.

• Compliance monitoring program: Support the development and roll-out of a firm-wide compliance monitoring program under senior guidance. Perform checks against approved test plans, retain supporting evidence, track findings and follow up on remediation actions.

• Regulatory change tracking: Track relevant AML/KYC and compliance developments in jurisdictions prioritised by the team, prepare summaries for senior review and support agreed updates to policies, controls and monitoring activities.

• Compliance reporting: Prepare and consolidate compliance KPIs and monitoring results for senior review ahead of management and board reporting, and support related internal review meetings.

• Training support: Support the maintenance of compliance training materials and records, including AML/KYC training for employees.

• Marketing materials review: Perform initial compliance checks of marketing materials (e.g. LinkedIn posts, presentations, press releases) against internal guidance, flag potential issues and coordinate senior review and final approval.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Compliance, Business, Finance, Law, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2–3 years of relevant experience in compliance, AML/KYC or a regulatory environment within financial services, or equivalent experience gained through other paths, including hands-on AML/KYC due diligence. Asset management or private markets experience is desirable.

• Practical knowledge of AML/KYC due diligence, with the ability to identify documentation gaps, record findings and recognise when to escalate. Familiarity with FATF-aligned frameworks is an advantage.

• Exposure to compliance monitoring programs, policy/procedure documentation, or regulatory change management is an advantage.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Spanish and additional languages such as French or German are an advantage.

• Detail-oriented and process-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, global environment.

• Proficiency with MS Office; familiarity with compliance, KYC, or contract-management systems is a plus.

Location
This role is based in Madrid, Spain, and forms part of Blue Earth Capital's global Legal & Compliance team.
Blue Earth Capital is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic, and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

drawn.title: Associate, Client Onboarding Specialist
drawn.body:
Who are we?

IEQ Capital is a Registered Investment Advisor seeking to transform traditional wealth management. Our quest is to integrate the Intellectual and Emotional Quotient, generating exceptional investment results driven by a values-oriented culture that fosters connection and collaboration with our clients. We are an independent, predominantly employee-owned company, adhering to the fiduciary standard to put our clients' interests first. We focus our efforts on helping clients meet their investment objectives without the distractions and limitations that can arise within much larger organizations.

The Role

IEQ Capital is seeking a polished, detail-oriented professional to join our team as a Client Onboarding Specialist. This role is focused on delivering a white-glove onboarding experience for new and existing clients, serving as a central point of coordination across clients, advisors, custodians, and internal teams. You will own the onboarding workflow from initial intake through account opening and funding, helping gather client information, facilitate clear communication, track outstanding items, and ensure each onboarding experience is handled with accuracy, responsiveness, and care. This position is well suited for someone who brings strong follow-through, sound judgment, and a client-first mindset to a fast-paced wealth management environment.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Own and coordinate the end-to-end client onboarding process, ensuring a seamless and high-touch experience from initial intake through account opening and funding.
  • Serve as a key point of contact during onboarding, facilitating timely and professional communication with clients, advisors, custodians, and internal stakeholders.
  • Gather, review, and organize client data and required documentation, proactively identifying gaps, inconsistencies, or outstanding items.
  • Prepare and generate new account paperwork for a variety of account types and custodians, ensuring documents are accurate, complete, and ready for client review and signature.
  • Process and track signed documentation, KYC records, and other regulatory documents to ensure timely and compliant completion.
  • Coordinate with custodians to facilitate account openings, resolve not-in-good-order items, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Provide proactive onboarding status updates to advisors and internal teams, highlighting next steps, risks, dependencies, and expected timing.
  • Enter, maintain, and update client, account, and onboarding data in Salesforce and other relevant systems with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Support Private Placement Document preparation and alternative investment subscription workflows, including tracking funding and subscription status.
  • Anticipate client and advisor needs throughout onboarding, helping remove friction points and drive a thoughtful, consistent client experience.
  • Partner with operations, advisory, compliance, and investment teams to resolve issues, streamline workflows, and improve the onboarding experience.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, documentation of best practices, and ongoing enhancements to onboarding standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 1-3+ years of relevant experience in client service, onboarding, operations, financial services, wealth management, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong client service orientation with the professionalism, judgment, and polish required to support a white-glove client experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain requirements, follow up effectively, and tailor communication to different audiences.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple onboarding workflows, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to think critically, identify issues, escalate appropriately, and propose practical solutions.
  • Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to build relationships across clients, advisors, custodians, and internal teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment with competing priorities and evolving timelines.
  • Experience with Salesforce, custodial platforms, or account-opening workflows is a plus.
  • A “no task is too small” mindset and a willingness to learn, take ownership, and grow within the firm.

Compensation

The total compensation range for this role, inclusive of base salary and bonus, is $70,000 - $100,000, depending on skills and experience.

drawn.body: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p><strong>Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure&nbsp;</strong>for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.<br><br>Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.<br><br>Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.<br><br><strong>Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.</strong><br><br><strong>Our Team Members:</strong></p> <p>We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!<br><br>We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Your Role:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Alpaca is building the infrastructure layer that partners across the Gulf use to launch and scale brokerage products. We're expanding our footprint in Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with live market access, a growing regional roadmap, and ambitions across derivatives, direct connectivity, securities lending, and Sharia-compliant offerings. We're hiring a Product Manager to own that expansion end-to-end: define the strategy, ship the products, and work with regulators, partners, and internal teams to make Alpaca the brokerage platform of choice across the Kingdom and the wider GCC.</p> <p>We're seeking a Product Manager to define and drive new product initiatives and manage a portfolio of existing products across the Saudi and GCC markets. With a deep understanding of the regional regulatory landscape, including CMA, Edaa, Tadawul, and GCC financial market frameworks, you will shape the product strategy that enables Alpaca to scale its brokerage infrastructure across the Kingdom and the wider Gulf region, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 and the region's rapidly evolving capital markets.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This role is equal parts strategy and delivery. You'll decide what we build versus buy, how we sequence the regional roadmap, and which partnerships and connectivity paths get us there — and then ship the brokerage features, integrations, and operational workflows that partners and institutional clients depend on every day.</p> <h2>What You'll Walk Into</h2> <p>You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Saudi limited live:&nbsp; scaling from initial market access to full product coverage while meeting CMA and Tadawul requirements.</li> launching derivative product offerings compliant with local market structure and regulation.</li> <li>Saudi direct connectivity:&nbsp; building and owning connectivity to Tadawul and regional infrastructure, reducing reliance on intermediary paths.</li> <li>Saudi broker partnerships: evaluating, onboarding, and integrating local brokers to expand coverage and resilience.</li> <li>Saudi securities lending business: growing the securities lending product line for the Kingdom.</li> <li>All of the above for the UAE: replicating and adapting the Saudi playbook for the Emirates market, Sharia-compliant structures are embedded across regional and global product surfaces.</li> <li>Regulatory and stakeholder complexity: engagements with CMA, Tadawul, Edaa, and other regional regulators, plus coordination between Alpaca's global platform and KSA/GCC market infrastructure.</li> </ul> <h2>Things You Get To Do</h2> <ul> <li>Own brokerage products tailored for the Saudi and GCC markets, including equities, Sukuk, ETFs, derivatives, and Sharia-compliant solutions.</li> <li>Drive brokerage product strategy by analyzing ROI, regional market competition, regulatory Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking a highly motivated and analytically rigorous banking professional with a foundational understanding of commercial banking, credit, and client relationship management. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with excellent communication and relationship-building skills and is interested in developing into a well-rounded banker capable of advising clients across a broad range of banking solutions.

This individual possesses a strong understanding of financial statement analysis, credit fundamentals, and commercial banking products, while also demonstrating the ability to identify business opportunities, develop client relationships, and collaborate across multiple business lines. They are intellectually curious, proactive, and committed to developing a comprehensive understanding of how the bank delivers value to clients.
The successful candidate will have opportunities to work closely with partners across Commercial Banking, Credit, Treasury & Payment Solutions, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth Management, and other specialized areas to support client growth, deepen relationships, and identify opportunities across the bank's platform.

Key Attributes

• Strong understanding of commercial banking, corporate finance, and credit fundamentals.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze financial statements, assess company performance, and evaluate financing opportunities.
• Interest in developing expertise across relationship management, business development, credit, treasury management, and strategic client advisory.
• Ability to identify opportunities to expand client relationships and connect clients with the broader capabilities of the bank.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with clients, prospects, and internal partners.
• Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and communication skills.
• Strategic thinker with sound business judgment and strong problem-solving capabilities.
• Naturally curious with a desire to continuously expand technical, industry, and banking knowledge.
• Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Collaborative team player who works effectively across functions and Lines of Business.
• Professional presence and confidence interacting with business owners, executives, and professional advisors.
• High degree of accountability, initiative, and attention to detail.

Development Opportunity
This role offers the opportunity to develop broad banking expertise through exposure to multiple disciplines and business lines across the organization. Associates will collaborate with and learn from professionals across:

• Commercial Banking
• Credit & Underwriting
• Treasury & Payment Solutions (TPS)
• Corporate Banking
• Investment Banking
• Capital Markets
• Wealth Management
• Private Banking

Through client engagements, cross-functional initiatives, and strategic projects, the successful candidate will gain experience in:

• Credit Analysis and Underwriting
• Financial Statement Analysis

• Deal Structuring
• Business Development and Relationship Expansion
• Treasury & Payment Solutions
• Capital Markets and Investment Banking Opportunity Identification

The ideal candidate is interested in building a comprehensive skill set that combines analytical rigor, client relationship management, business development, and strategic advisory capabilities, positioning them for future growth opportunities across Commercial Banking and the broader organization.

Preferred Experience

• 3–7 years of experience in Commercial Banking, Corporate Banking, Credit, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance, Treasury Management, or a related financial services discipline.
• Experience supporting credit underwriting, financial analysis, transaction execution, client relationship management, or business development activities.
• Working knowledge of commercial lending, treasury management, and banking solutions for commercial clients.
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.

Salaried

drawn.title: Associate, Research
drawn.body:
Who Are We?

IEQ Capital is a Registered Investment Advisor seeking to transform traditional wealth management. Our quest is to integrate the Intellectual and Emotional Quotient, generating exceptional investment results driven by a values-oriented culture that fosters connection and collaboration with our clients. We are an independent, predominantly employee-owned company, adhering to the fiduciary standard to put our clients' interests first. We focus our efforts on helping clients meet their investment objectives without the distractions and limitations that can arise within much larger organizations.

The Role

IEQ Capital is looking for a motivated professional to join our team as a Research Associate working across Alternative Investments and Public Markets. The Research Associate will work closely with the client-facing team to manage important elements of the investment process. We are seeking candidates who can be based in our San Francisco office. Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead the ongoing monitoring of existing Alternative Investments across asset classes—including real estate, private credit, private equity, and venture—by producing clear, timely, and informative updates tailored to both clients and advisors.
    • This includes tracking fund performance, market developments, manager updates, and material events.
  • Contribute to market commentary and strategy across private markets, public equity, and fixed income.
  • As you grow into the role, you will also support the investments team in conducting due diligence on Public and Alternative Investments, including:
    • Market and downside scenario analysis, manager due diligence, and direct/co-investment deal assessments with full risk and return analysis.
    • Participation in Investment Committee meetings, supporting due diligence on pipeline opportunities, and preparing related materials such as IC memos, presentation decks, and supporting documentation.
    • Assisting with onboarding new funds to IEQ Capital’s Alternative Investments platform by drafting investment and marketing materials, including pitch decks, one-pagers, and pitch sheets for clients and advisors.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; 1–2 years of relevant internship or work experience preferred (motivated new graduates will be considered).
  • Strong foundation in financial markets, alternative investments, and macroeconomics.
  • Experience with financial modeling and data analysis (Excel required; Python, R, or Salesforce a plus).
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and written/verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive and accountable self-starter able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and contribute meaningfully to team objectives.
  • Genuine passion for markets and curiosity about alternative investment strategies.
  • An individual looking to continuously learn and be challenged.

Compensation

The salary range for this role, inclusive of base and bonus, is $90,000 - $115,000, depending on skills and experience.

drawn.title: Internal Audit - Liquidity Risk Management
drawn.body:
Audit Manager, Liquidity Risk Management AVP

About the Team
The Internal Audit Department Americas (IADA) is an independent and objective assurance and advisory function responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes across Mizuho's U.S. Operations (MUSO), including banking, broker-dealer, swap dealer, sales, and trading activities.

Based in New York City , IADA provides comprehensive audit coverage of key business functions and risk areas to help ensure regulatory compliance, operational effectiveness, and sound risk management practices.

Position Summary
The Audit Manager/Senior Audit Manager will be a key member of the Liquidity Risk Audit Team within IADA. This role is responsible for executing risk-based audits across liquidity, treasury, and capital management functions, providing independent assurance over the effectiveness of controls and governance processes. The successful candidate will partner with stakeholders across the organization, remain current on regulatory developments, and contribute to the continuous enhancement of the audit function.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute audits within the Liquidity Risk Management audit universe, including:

• Liquidity Risk Management

• Independent Liquidity Review Function

• Treasury Banking Functions

• Capital Management

• Independent Price Verification (IPV) Framework

• Perform audit activities across all phases of the audit lifecycle, including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and issue follow-up, in accordance with IADA methodology and professional standards.

• Adhere to established audit timelines, project plans, and departmental scheduling requirements.

• Support the Continuous Monitoring Program by assessing emerging risks, monitoring changes within the liquidity risk environment, and validating the remediation of audit issues.

• Collaborate with other Internal Audit teams to support integrated audits and provide subject matter expertise when required.

• Conduct special audits, regulatory reviews, investigations, and other ad hoc projects as assigned.

• Maintain knowledge of applicable banking regulations, supervisory expectations, and industry developments affecting liquidity, treasury, and capital management activities.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with business management, risk and control functions, external auditors, regulatory agencies, and audit colleagues.

• Support quality assurance initiatives and continuously promote adherence to audit standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Qualifications
Education & Certifications

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• Professional certifications such as CPA, CA, CIA, CISA, or equivalent are preferred.

Experience

• 5-7 years of relevant experience in internal audit, external audit, regulatory examination, risk management, or a related control function within the financial services industry.

• Experience auditing liquidity risk, treasury, capital management, market risk, or related banking functions is strongly preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

• Strong understanding of internal audit principles, standards, practices, and methodologies.

• Knowledge of risk management frameworks, internal controls, governance processes, and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Familiarity with key banking and securities regulations and the ability to assess associated risks and controls.

• Ability to independently plan and execute audits in accordance with professional auditing standards and organizational policies.

• Experience leveraging data analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools, or other technology solutions to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness.

• Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare high-quality audit documentation and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

• Proven project management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Attributes

• Strong understanding of liquidity risk management practices within a banking environment.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and functions.

• Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and staying current with evolving regulatory expectations and industry developments.

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality audit outcomes.

The expected base salary ranges from $107,000.00 - $160,000.00 Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, including but not limited to Medical, Dental and 401k that begin on day one of employment, successful candidates are also eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

Mizuho’s Banking Division provides corporate and investment banking coverage, sponsor coverage, advisory and solutions and loan capital markets/syndicate to Mizuho’s client base of leading international corporations, financial institutions and public sector entities in the US and Canada.

Banking supports client business activities throughout the region with an extensive range of capital markets and lending capabilities and an integrated team of coverage, advisory and product bankers responsible for client relationship management and strategic transaction development to execute banking and securities mandates and originate idea generation for potential acquisitions, divestitures and investment opportunities.

Job Summary :
U.S. Investment Banking Associates are directly involved in the design, origination, structuring and execution of mergers & acquisitions, equity and debt capital markets, leveraged finance and other global products and services for existing and prospective Mizuho clients. drawn.body: <div class="content-intro"><p>MIO Partners Inc. (MIO) is a global, world-class investment and advisory institution with a decades-long track record of performance for our clients through multiple market cycles. Our team of approximately 250 people provides asset management and advisory services to current and former McKinsey employees. We manage more than $20 billion in assets across public and private markets. We are headquartered in New York City, with offices in Atlanta, Georgia; &nbsp;West Palm Beach, Florida; Germany; Hong Kong; Singapore; Spain; and the UK.</p> <p>We provide objective advice on long-term wealth building and create distinctive investment products that deliver value relative to market-based benchmarks. We operate two core lines of business: (i) our advisory team provides advice, wealth planning, and retirement services to approximately 2500 individual clients, and (ii) our investments business consists of alpha-seeking alternative investment strategies across public and private markets.&nbsp;</p> <p>A defining characteristic of our business is our perfect alignment with our clients. Our extraordinary mandate as a boutique investment and advisory firm, grounded in a core set of principles, enables us to create unique products and services while keeping our clients’ interests front and center.&nbsp;</p> <p>Much of our success can be attributed to our insatiable intellectual curiosity. drawn.title: Accounting Manager
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join the Finance team at a growing healthtech business as Accounting Manager. You will oversee core accounting operations and strengthen financial controls, reporting, and processes across eCommerce, inventory, and healthcare-related activities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead the month-end close, including reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting.

- Oversee revenue recognition, inventory, intercompany accounting, payroll, accounts payable and receivable, and fixed assets.

- Review financial statements and internal reporting packages, and analyze balance sheet and P&L fluctuations to provide business insights.

- Manage cash flow forecasting, banking relationships, and liquidity.

- Partner with Supply Chain on inventory controls, reporting, forecasting, cycle counts, and inventory turns.

- Develop accounting policies and documentation, and implement process improvements and automation.

- Manage and develop staff accountants, support external audits and public reporting readiness, and collaborate across teams.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field, with 5 or more years of accounting experience including public accounting, and 2 to 3 years in an accounting manager role.

- Strong U.S. GAAP and technical accounting knowledge; CPA certification is preferred.

- Experience with ERP systems and strong Excel skills for financial analysis and reporting.

- Experience managing complex accounting operations in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, and turning financial analysis into clear business insights.

- People management experience; background in eCommerce, healthcare, telemedicine, or inventory-based businesses is preferred.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation is $90,000 to $110,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

LOCATION

This is a hybrid role based in San Leandro, California, United States.

drawn.title: Managing Consultant - Revenue Cycle - Healthcare
drawn.body:
We Do Consulting Differently

The Integrated Health Solutions (IHS) practice at Berkeley Research Group (BRG) provides end-to-end advisory support to healthcare providers, payers, investors, and other stakeholders navigating complex strategic, operational, financial, and clinical challenges. Led by seasoned healthcare executives, operators, and clinicians, IHS partners with organizations to drive sustainable performance improvement and long-term growth through strategic growth design, operating model transformation, AI and digital enablement, clinical quality and patient care optimization, and revenue strategy—helping clients build resilient, future-ready healthcare enterprises in an increasingly complex environment.

Our four core service offerings include:

• Business Transformation Advisory
• Margin & Operational Improvement
• Clinical & Quality Transformation
• AI & Digital Solutions

Margin & Operational Improvement drives measurable financial improvement by providing clients with comprehensive solutions designed to increase revenue, optimizing cost containment strategies. This division utilizes innovative approaches to transform operating models and deliver true sustainable margin improvement. Our team of operational leaders, business analysts and experienced subject matter experts focuses on implementing solutions around the following focus areas:

• Workforce productivity and Human Resources
• Supply chain and Corporate Overhead performance
• Revenue Cycle effectiveness
• Managed care, Revenue Integrity and Pricing Strategies
• Ambulatory Operations and Physician Enterprise

Position Summary
The Managing Consultant position is a mid-to-senior level consulting staff position. This position requires a highly motivated problem solver with strong analytical ability and a desire to advance within the organization. An individual with an entrepreneurial spirit and an ability to apply creative solutions is a natural fit for this position.

The work of a Managing Consultant will involve both execution and oversight of engagement work streams that may be either qualitative or quantitative in nature, and responsibilities include management of junior staff, design of statistical and financial analysis, modeling of financial data and markets, quality control, development and presentation of client deliverables, management of existing client relationships, industry research, and business development and practice growth.

Travel Requirements
Willing to travel consistently (50%–80%), depending on project requirements and client expectations, is required for this position.

Responsibilities

• Plan and manage all aspects of small to medium sized client engagements and discrete segments of larger projects. Responsible for leading initiatives that span the Revenue Cycle continuum including Patient Access, HIM/Coding, Charge Capture, Revenue Integrity, Denials/Underpayments Management and Recovery, Patient Financial Services.
• Accountable for achieving operational and financial performance improvements for each engagement, including but not limited to reducing Discharged Not Final Billed (DNFB) and A/R days, driving cash acceleration activity, increasing insurance verification rates, increasing Medicaid eligibility conversions, increasing timely claim submissions, preventing denials and collections inefficiencies, managing vendor relationships, and decreasing bad debt.
• Lead current-state assessments, opportunity quantification analyses, and development of actionable recommendations to improve revenue cycle performance.
• Responsible for creating project charters, workplans, realization schedules, benefit tracking tools, client deliverables/work products, and transition planning documents.
• Delegate assignments to staff, instruct and monitor progress, and review work products for completeness and accuracy.
• Develop analyses and financial models using transactional data and/or financial data.
• Develop and maintain benefit realization models and monitor project performance against established operational and financial targets.
• Generate client deliverables and make valuable contributions to practice articles and whitepapers.
• Manage client relationships with senior-level client leadership and communicate results and work products to executive stakeholders.
• Demonstrate creativity and efficient use of relevant software tools, analytical methods and computer models to develop solutions.
• Participate in group practice meetings, contribute to business development initiatives and office functions such as staff training and recruiting.
• Adhere to project budget and hours by prioritizing assignments and responsibilities in order to meet goals and deadlines.

Qualifications

• 6 - 8+ years of healthcare industry or consulting experience in Revenue Cycle operations, including performance improvement and process re-engineering, revenue management and redesign, and reimbursement and recovery strategies. Previous consulting experience is highly preferred.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (e.g., BS, BBA, MBA, MHA, M.A., M.S., etc.) with a preferred focus in Management, Accounting, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related discipline.
• Applicable industry certification is preferred (e.g., CRCR, CHFP, CHAM, CRCE-I, CRCE-P, etc.).
• Extensive operational expertise in any of the following Revenue Cycle functions: Patient Access, HIM/Coding, Charge Capture, Revenue Integrity, Denials/Underpayments Management and Recovery, Patient Financial Services.
• Strong project management experience and proven success contributing to assessments and project implementations
• Experience leveraging revenue cycle technologies, automation tools, AI-enabled workflows, and analytics platforms to drive operational and financial performance improvements.
• Ability to draft work plans, project budgets, timelines, and deliverables
• Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively manage team and client relationships
• Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. Ability to present findings and recommendations to Vice Presidents, CFOs, Revenue Cycle Executives, and other senior healthcare leaders. Ability to succeed in a high-performance and rapid team environment where client expectations are consistently met or exceeded
• Demonstrated ability to lead project teams, mentor junior consultants, and manage multiple concurrent workstreams. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Access, and Outlook
• Familiarity with Epic, Cerner, Allscripts, MEDITECH, Athena/IDX desired

Managing Consultant Salary Range: $120,000 – $165,000 per year.
Job title and compensation to be determined based on qualifications and experience.

Candidate must be able to submit verification of his/her legal right to work in the U.S., without company sponsorship.

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. drawn.title: Associate, GTB (Global Transaction Banking) Advisory
drawn.body:
Department: Global Transaction Banking Division Americas
Function: Product - GTB Advisory

General Department Description
Global Transaction Banking Division Americas provides transaction banking solutions across payments and collections, cash and liquidity management, trade finance, supply chain finance, commercial card, receivables finance, and related treasury capabilities. The division serves corporate clients across the Americas and works closely with Coverage, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Mizuho’s global network.

Summary
The Associate, GTB Advisory supports the Director, GTB Advisory in translating client needs, market intelligence and strategic priorities into actionable product, commercial and organizational outcomes. The role conducts research and analysis, prepares executive and client materials, supports complex transaction-banking solutions and strategic opportunities, and coordinates deliverables across Product, Sales, Coverage, Operations, Technology, Risk and other control partners. Through disciplined execution, accurate reporting and structured stakeholder follow-up, the role strengthens the division’s advisory capability, commercialization agenda and delivery of strategic transformation priorities.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

• Strategic Research and Analysis: Conduct market, competitor and industry research across cash management, payments, liquidity, trade finance, working capital, treasury technology, APIs, digital assets, emerging automation capabilities and relevant fintech developments; synthesize findings into concise briefings, business cases and recommendations for Product and division leadership.
• Client, Product and Commercial Support: Support senior advisory colleagues in client meetings, treasury reviews, strategic opportunities and RFPs; analyze client feedback and needs; prepare tailored presentations and solution materials; and provide Product and Sales teams with evidence to assess enhancements, commercialization priorities and cross-product opportunities.
• Complex Solution and Stakeholder Coordination: Gather and organize inputs from Product, Sales, Coverage, Operations, Technology, Credit, Risk, Compliance and Legal; perform supporting analysis; maintain action logs and implementation dependencies; and escalate gaps or blockers promptly to the Director, GTB Advisory.
• Reporting, Data Quality and Controls: Maintain accurate client-feedback repositories, opportunity analyses, initiative trackers, supporting records and management materials; follow applicable confidentiality, documentation, approval, records-management and control requirements; and correct or escalate data quality and control exceptions within agreed timelines.
• Strategic Initiatives and Knowledge Sharing: Support assigned strategic and enterprise initiatives through research, workplan tracking, governance materials and follow-up; document reusable insights, solution frameworks, templates and playbooks; and contribute to team training and knowledge-sharing activities.
• Cross-Functional Development: Participate actively in cross-functional assignments by maintaining visibility of capacity and deadlines, completing work across relevant products, clients, analyses, presentations, and strategic initiatives, escalating workload conflicts promptly, and seeking structured feedback after significant assignments.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, international affairs, data analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
• Professional Experience: Two to six years of relevant experience in transaction banking, treasury services, consulting, corporate or commercial banking, financial-services strategy, analytics, product management, or a related client-facing function.
• Technical Knowledge: Working knowledge of transaction banking and corporate treasury concepts, with the ability to develop expertise across cash management, payments, liquidity, deposits, trade finance, working capital, and treasury technology; proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
• Skills: Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, written and verbal communication, presentation development, attention to detail, organization, and collaboration.
• Language: English required. Japanese is preferred; Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language relevant to the Americas client base is a plus.
• Travel: Ability to travel as required for client meetings, industry events, and business needs.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting client-facing, product, strategy or consulting teams in a global financial institution;
exposure to strategic planning, competitive intelligence, product commercialization, complex solution
development or executive communications; familiarity with Japanese and non-Japanese multinational clients;
and a relevant advanced degree or professional credential.

Work Location
In-office presence is an essential function of this role, and this role requires work from the office five days per
week. Remote work may be used on an as-needed and ad hoc basis in accordance with applicable Banking
policies.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Mizuho does not sponsor applicants for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, any sponsorship or administrative assistance or execution of any documentation related to F-1 (CPT/OPT/STEM OPT), TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1 or H-1B application.

The expected base salary ranges from $93,000 - $140,000. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, including Medical, Dental and 401K plans, successful candidates are also eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

Greenhill & Co., Inc., part of Mizuho Americas, is focused on providing financial advice on significant mergers, acquisitions, restructurings, financings and capital raising to corporations, partnerships, institutions and governments globally. It acts on behalf of clients throughout the world from its offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC .

drawn.title: Asset Management - Associate
drawn.body: Associate, Asset Management Atlanta, GA Opportunity and Position Summary: Stockbridge is seeking an Asset Management Associate to join our Atlanta team. This is an opportunity for a motivated professional to work directly alongside experienced Asset Managers and gain broad exposure to the full lifecycle of property ownership. This role covers two of the fastest-growing markets in the country, Nashville and Raleigh/Durham, with a strong-performing portfolio of properties spanning office, mixed-use, residential, industrial, retail, and ground-up development. The Associate will play an important role in evaluating performance, developing and executing asset strategies, analyzing new opportunities, and supporting decisions that drive value across a diverse portfolio. The position combines rigorous financial analysis with strategic thinking, relationship management, and hands-on execution. This is a highly collaborative role with meaningful exposure to senior leadership, Investment Committee, joint-venture partners, property managers, leasing professionals, lenders, brokers, attorneys, and other key stakeholders. The successful candidate will progressively take ownership of assignments and transactions while developing the judgment and skills needed to become a well-rounded Real Estate professional. The role requires strong quantitative and qualitative capabilities, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, excellent communication skills, and a genuine desire to learn, contribute, and grow. Primary Duties and Responsibilities: Build and review sophisticated financial models for property valuations, dispositions, recapitalizations, lease analyses, joint-venture waterfalls, complex deal structures, and portfolio-level analysis. Monitor asset and portfolio performance against business plans and investment objectives, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention. Assist in the preparation, review, and execution of annual property budgets, business plans, and asset strategies. Synthesize property, market, and financial data into clear conclusions and actionable recommendations. Conduct due diligence on potential acquisitions, including expense analysis, underwriting review, and evaluation of key investment considerations. Work with Asset Managers to develop and execute asset strategies designed to maximize value and achieve portfolio objectives. Provide oversight of third-party property managers, leasing brokers, joint-venture partners, and other service providers while developing strong, productive relationships. Work alongside Asset Managers and owner's construction representatives in overseeing ground-up development, redevelopment, and capital projects. Provide support throughout disposition and refinance transactions and communicate status updates. Attend weekly Investment Committee meetings, preparing supporting materials for senior management as needed and contributing analysis and recommendations on active transactions and asset strategies. Develop the ability to review work produced by Analysts, provide direction, and serve as a mentor as appropriate. Take increasing ownership of assignments and manage projects with limited supervision. Conduct property visits and market tours with Asset Managers, developing firsthand market knowledge and property-level insight to support underwriting, asset strategy, and investment recommendations. Skills and Competencies: Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution; preferred fields include real estate, finance, business, accounting, economics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of relevant real estate or finance experience, preferably including asset management, acquisitions, dispositions, valuation, portfolio analysis, cash flow forecasting, or debt. Strong understanding of the fundamentals of the real estate investment business. Advanced proficiency in Argus and Excel, with demonstrated financial modeling experience including complex deal structures, portfolios, and/or waterfalls; familiarity with leasing and portfolio management platforms (e.g., VTS, Yardi, CoStar) is preferred. Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to evaluate information, identify key risks, and reach sound conclusions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create polished presentations and effectively communicate analysis and recommendations. Robust organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects, transactions, and competing priorities simultaneously. Intellectually curious, self-motivated, proactive, and willing to take initiative rather than wait to be directed. Confident and professionally mature, with the judgment and presence to interact effectively with senior professionals and external stakeholders. Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment and adjust to changing priorities. Accountable and entrepreneurial, taking ownership of assignments and following them through to completion. Collaborative while also comfortable working independently and making decisions within established parameters. Receptive to feedback and committed to continuously improving. Relationship-oriented, with the ability to build credibility and trust with brokers, lenders, property managers, partners, and colleagues. Strategic in thinking, with the ability to move beyond the numbers to understand what drives value and risk in an investment. Demonstrated ability and interest in mentoring Analysts, providing constructive feedback and hands-on guidance to help them build technical skills, judgment, and confidence. The Firm: Stockbridge is a real estate investment management firm led by senior professionals averaging 25 years of real estate industry experience. The firm was founded in 2003 and manages real estate equity investments across the risk spectrum within a variety of investment structures on behalf of U.S. and foreign institutional investors, family offices and high net worth individuals. Stockbridge has approximately $27.4 billion of assets under management spanning all major real estate property types, and certain specialty property types with an emphasis on residential and industrial space throughout the U.S. The firm has offices in San Francisco, Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, and Phoenix. This role requires a minimum of four days in the office. Why Stockbridge: This position offers the opportunity to build a broad and sophisticated foundation in real estate and asset management while working alongside experienced professionals across multiple property types and investment strategies. Our Atlanta office pairs the rigor and resources of an institutional platform with the energy of a close-knit team of approximately 50-60 professionals. There is direct, regular access to senior leadership, and a collaborative, open-door culture where good ideas are welcomed regardless of title or tenure. You will have exposure to the decisions that drive investment performance—not simply the process of reporting it. As your experience grows, so will your responsibility, providing a clear opportunity to develop greater ownership of assets, transactions, and strategic initiatives. For the right candidate, this is an opportunity to become a well-rounded real estate professional with experience spanning financial analysis, asset strategy, transactions, development and redevelopment, portfolio management, and relationship management. Compensation: Competitive. Stockbridge's base pay scale depends on geographic location, business line, years of experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. A discretionary annual bonus is also included in addition to base pay. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life and STD & LTD insurance. Stockbridge provides a 401K plan with a match as well as generous vacation, sick time and holiday time off. Additionally, Stockbridge provides opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Contact Info: Please apply through the company career page at www.stockbridge.com. No phone calls please. Selection will be based solely on merit and will be without discrimination because of age, sex, sexual orientation, race, religion, national origin, marital status or disability. All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Any applicant selected for this position will be required to submit to an extensive background screening and a credit check. drawn.body: DESCRIPTION: Duties: Conduct comprehensive financial and wealth planning analyses to identify and address Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) Brazilian clients' unique objectives. Perform advanced economic and market analysis, utilizing advanced financial modeling and asset valuation concepts to inform investment decisions that align with clients' long-term investment goals and family wealth structures. Use the Portuguese language to validate the clients' current investment objectives and to prepare tailored recommendations for appropriate investment products that ensure regulatory compliance. Perform market analysis to tailor solutions that meet Brazilian clients' evolving needs, and provide sophisticated advisory services to UHNW Brazilian clients on asset allocation strategies, portfolio construction, tactical trading shifts, rebalancing, and hedging to optimize returns while managing risk, communicating these strategies to clients in Portuguese. Interpret Brazilian market practices and regulatory considerations that are communicated in Portuguese to ensure compliant and appropriate structuring and portfolio allocation. Monitor portfolios through risk analysis, performance tracking, and asset allocation reviews, and generate trade ideas based on reviewing market analysis against clients' objectives. Execute solutions encompassing Mutual Funds, Structured Products, Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Foreign Exchange, Equities, Options, Derivatives, and Swaps. Provide cross-asset class execution including equities, fixed income, derivatives, and alternatives based on market conditions and global trends. Review and synthesize Portuguese language materials including financial statements, operational reports, and legal/regulatory guidance relevant to client portfolios and cross border products (e.g., FX forwards, cross currency swaps, and structured notes linked to Brazilian assets). Conduct and participate in meetings, calls, and negotiations with Brazilian UHNW clients and counterparties where Portuguese is the primary or exclusive business language, ensuring accurate communication in Portuguese on investment strategy, risk, and suitability. Advise clients on how global macroeconomic developments affect their portfolios. Develop investment policy statements in Portuguese and provide strategic allocation advice aligned with evolving client objectives. Deliver presentations in Portuguese on market views, investment strategy, and portfolio reviews. Serve as an interface between clients and bank areas including credit, mortgage, investment, and wealth advisory teams, coordinating holistic financial solutions for Brazilian clients in both onshore and offshore markets. This position requires up to 20% travel (domestic, primarily to New York, and international, primarily to Brazil) to various client sites and JPMC offices for internal meetings/trainings. QUALIFICATIONS: Minimum education and experience required: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field of study plus four (4) years of experience in the job offered or as Investment Advisor, Investment Specialist, Banker Advisor, or related occupation. Skills Required: This position requires four (4) years of experience with the following skills: providing wealth management, private banking, or investment advisory services to Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) clients whose liquid net worth exceeds $15 million USD; allocating financial assets and constructing portfolios across equities, fixed income, structured products, derivatives, hedge funds, private equity, real estate, venture capital, commodities, and liquid alternatives; analyzing Brazilian financial markets including Brazilian equities, fixed income, debentures, local hedge funds, and onshore investment vehicles; reviewing Brazilian financial regulations governing cross-border investments including Brazilian Law 4131, Brazilian tax regulations, fiduciary structures, succession planning for UHNW families, US Dodd-Frank Act, and Commodity Futures Trading Commission rules governing derivatives and swaps; structuring and executing derivative transactions using structured products; applying quantitative and statistical modeling methods for investment analysis and projections including Monte Carlo simulation, probabilistic modeling, probability distributions, correlation and covariance analysis, and multi-period projection techniques; conducting analysis using cross-currency instruments including foreign exchange forwards, cross- currency swaps in Brazilian Reals currency, currency-linked structured products, and total return swaps involving Brazilian equities; reviewing KYC and AML compliance in US and Brazilian frameworks; and conducting analysis in Microsoft Excel including VBA programming for financial modeling. This position requires oral, auditory, and written fluency in the Portuguese language. This position requires the following license(s): FINRA Series 7; and FINRA SIE. Job Location: 1450 Brickell Avenue, Miami, FL 33131. This position requires up to 20% travel (domestic, primarily to New York, and international, primarily to Brazil) to various client sites and JPMC offices for internal meetings/trainings. Full-Time. Conduct comprehensive financial and wealth planning analyses to identify and address Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) Brazilian clients' unique objectives.

Job Description:
We are seeking an AVP to support Markets FP&A, covering revenues and expenses for the Fixed Income (FID) and Equities (EQ) LOBs across Mizuho Americas. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to partner with business managers, COOs, Product Control and head office (Japan).

· Prepare senior management presentations and ad hoc analysis on revenue and cost drivers by desk and product
· Support the weekly/monthly forecast and annual budget for FID and EQ

· Analyze direct and allocated expenses and support monthly cost reviews with business COOs
· Maintain reporting standards and data integrity for FID and EQ per HO (Japan) requirements
· Maintain hierarchies and mappings (desks, trading books, cost centers, entities) across systems
· Support monthly allocations and inter-entity reconciliations across Americas legal entities
· Help streamline and automate reporting, forecasting and budgeting processes, including in OneStream
· Respond to ad hoc requests from HO (Japan), LOB leads and Finance partners

· Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field (CPA/CFA a plus)
· 3–5 years of financial services experience, including 2+ years in FP&A, product control or financial analysis
· Experience supporting Fixed Income and/or Equities businesses in a finance role strongly preferred
· Working knowledge of FID and EQ products (e.g., rates, credit, securitized products, cash equities, derivatives) and their revenue/expense drivers
· Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with OneStream, Hyperion, Anaplan or PeopleSoft
· Understanding of income statement data across business line, desk, entity and head office reporting dimensions
· Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring deadlines with minimal supervision
· Clear communicator with strong problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications:
· Familiarity with US GAAP and/or IFRS
· Knowledge of GL concepts (profit/cost centers, trading books, allocations, inter-entity transfers) at an investment bank or broker-dealer
· Experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL or Python
· Experience at a foreign or Japanese bank with head office reporting requirements

drawn.title: AI/ML Engineer
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage, venture-backed AI startup reimagining computer-aided engineering (CAE) for the AI era. As an AI/ML Engineer, you'll shape the future of engineering automation by building AI that thinks like an engineer — designing, training, and deploying models that accelerate simulation, improve accuracy, and unlock entirely new ways of exploring the design space. From adaptive solvers and reduced-order modeling to generative design and real-time validation, your work will push the boundaries of what CAE can achieve.

You'll collaborate closely with experts in applied AI and mechanical engineering, integrating machine learning directly into high-fidelity simulation pipelines to help customers iterate faster, diagnose failures earlier, and bring better products to market. This is a rare opportunity to join early and make a foundational impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Research, design, and develop AI/ML algorithms to tackle complex challenges in simulation, design automation, and computer-aided engineering.

- Build scalable AI solutions and collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate models seamlessly into existing CAE workflows and infrastructure.

- Lead performance improvements — from optimizing model accuracy to analyzing outputs and addressing system-level bottlenecks.

- Guide AI/ML projects from research through to production deployment.

- Contribute to MLOps practices and help build robust, end-to-end AI/ML systems.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

- 4+ years of experience developing and deploying AI/ML models with a proven track record of delivering impact in applied engineering or scientific domains.

- 2+ years of technical leadership guiding AI/ML projects from research to production.

- Proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow).

- Experience with AI/ML algorithms for sequential, spatial, or physics-informed data (e.g., time series, mesh data, or simulation outputs).

- Familiarity with MLOps practices and building AI/ML systems end-to-end, from prototyping to scalable deployment.

- Strong understanding of engineering principles in simulation, modeling, and optimization.

- Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to Have:

- Experience with CAE, CAD, and/or PLM tools (e.g., Ansys, Abaqus, COMSOL, SolidWorks, NX).

- Experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Salary: $150,000 – $250,000 USD annually

- Visa sponsorship available

LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, CA, United States. Candidates must be available to work from the San Francisco office.

Woodstock, New Brunswick, Canada

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:
Department Overview:
At TD Canada Trust, we are the frontline of TD Bank. We strive to build deep and long-lasting relationships with our customers by performing a broad range of customer service transactions and providing information and advice on services, products, and solutions to existing or prospective TD customers. At the branch, we understand customer needs and identify opportunities to promote products and services to refer customers to the appropriate team member or internal Bank partner, while ensuring a positive customer experience.

Join TD Canada Trust and Think like a customer, Act like an Owner, Innovate with purpose and Execute with Speed and Impact.

Job Description:
Do you thrive in leading a medium-sized team to initiate great customer conversations and create a pleasant and positive customer experience? Can you provide your mentorship, subject matter expertise and support in achieving business results while adhering to internal policies, practices, and processes? As Branch Manager , strive for excellence and execute with speed, raising the bar around you.

A typical day at work might look like:
• Mentor the team on advice-giving strategies on banking solutions to improve the overall customer experience and financial confidence
• Promote TD's image and goodwill within the community by participating in community events
• Enhance customer experience by understanding their financial needs and providing appropriate solutions
• Act as the highest point of escalation for the branch to ensure customer issues are handled in the best course of action and participate in the resolution of reported matters when required
• Oversee complex branch administrative duties for mutual funds, real estate secured credit, and other compliance-related issues
• Ensure overall employee scheduling is optimal
• Develop and implement business development strategies within the budget and communicate results to the team to meet business objectives
• Ensure accuracy of all customer transactions as per TD's policies to achieve operational excellence
• Mentor the team on offering One TD solutions and building lasting relationships with customers
• Liaise with Wealth and Business Banking to stay updated with processes, emerging issues, and industry regulations
• Cultivate a positive and customer-focused work environment that builds productivity, innovation, operational improvement, and professionalism

Job Requirements:
• Undergraduate degree and/or over 5 years of relevant experience
