• Proficiency in software tools including MS Office, and internet application
• Strong communication skills to liaise with customers, employees, and cross functional teams
• A thorough and accurate decision maker who can exercise discretion and judgement skills when working with confidential information
• A dedicated and committed leader who can make an impact on the team and positively influence them and achieve results with effective negotiation, problem-solving and communication skills

Who We Are:
TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

We look forward to hearing from you!

drawn.body:
Department: Global Transaction Banking Division Americas
Function: Sales - BA Sales

General Department Description
Global Transaction Banking Division Americas provides transaction banking solutions across payments and collections, cash and liquidity management, trade finance, supply chain finance, commercial card, receivables finance, and related treasury capabilities. The division serves corporate clients across the Americas and works closely with Coverage, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Mizuho’s global network.

Summary
The Associate, BA Sales supports origination and execution across Banking Americas clients by preparing client and industry analysis, developing proposals and RFP responses, maintaining pipeline and call records, coordinating opportunity actions, and supporting handoff to Product, Onboarding, Execution & Delivery and Client Experience. The role participates in the cross-functional assignment model to build broad product, client and execution capability.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

• Sales Support: Prepare client research, treasury and working-capital analysis, opportunity briefs, presentation materials, proposals and RFP responses for assigned BA opportunities.
• Opportunity Execution: Coordinate action plans, pricing inputs, internal approvals, documentation requests and handoffs across Sales, Product, Relationship Management, Credit, Legal, Onboarding and Client Experience.
• Client and Stakeholder Support: Participate in client meetings as assigned, prepare agendas and materials, and circulate accurate follow-up actions within agreed timelines.
• Pipeline and Data Quality: Maintain complete and timely pipeline, client activity, revenue and milestone data; reconcile exceptions and escalate gaps before reporting deadlines.
• Risk and Controls: Follow applicable policies, procedures, approval standards and information-handling requirements; support timely remediation of assigned control items.
• Cross-Functional Development: Maintain current assignment and capacity information, execute a balanced mix of assignments, escalate workload conflicts early, seek feedback, and contribute reusable materials.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree required; finance, business, economics, or a related field preferred.
• Professional Experience: Two to five years of relevant experience in transaction banking, treasury services, corporate banking, financial analysis, or sales support.
• Technical Knowledge: Working knowledge of cash management and trade finance products, financial analysis, pipeline reporting, and presentation development.
• Skills: Strong analytical, organizational, writing, and presentation skills; proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; ability to manage multiple deadlines.
• Language: English required. Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language is a plus.
• Travel: Limited, based on client and business needs.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a global bank or corporate treasury environment; exposure to client analytics, RFPs, cash management, or trade finance; CTP coursework or other relevant professional development.

Work Location
In-office presence is an essential function of this role, and this role requires work from the office five days per week. Remote work may be used on an as-needed and ad hoc basis in accordance with applicable Banking policies.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Mizuho does not sponsor applicants for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, any sponsorship or administrative assistance or execution of any documentation related to F-1 (CPT/OPT/STEM OPT), TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1 or H-1B application.

The expected base salary ranges from $93,000 - $140,000. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, including Medical, Dental and 401K plans, successful candidates are also eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

Greenhill & Co., Inc., part of Mizuho Americas, is focused on providing financial advice on significant mergers, acquisitions, restructurings, financings and capital raising to corporations, partnerships, institutions and governments globally. It acts on behalf of clients throughout the world from its offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC .

drawn.title: Team Lead, Wealth Management
drawn.body:
Who are we?

IEQ Capital is a Registered Investment Advisor seeking to transform traditional wealth management. Our quest is to integrate the Intellectual and Emotional Quotient, driven by a values-oriented culture that fosters connection and collaboration with our clients. We are an independent, predominantly employee-owned company, adhering to the standard to put our clients' interests first. We focus our efforts on helping clients meet their investment objectives without the distractions and limitations that can arise within much larger organizations.

The Role

The Team Lead role is designed to centralize managerial responsibilities within a client service team, empowering fellow team members to focus on service and client relationship management and other firm level priorities. The TL is critical to supporting the client-facing team in strategic planning, communication management, and overall team organization. The TL will work in conjunction with the Team Manager to manage the entire coverage team.

Team Leads enhance and manage scaling of individual and teamwide capabilities, with direct reports including team members at the Associate and Senior Associate levels. Team Leads actively train, educate, and engage with junior team members to promote growth and career advancement, specifically on client service and relationship management and investment knowledge.

Team Leads work closely with their client-service teams to manage important elements of day-to-day responsibilities and ensure tasks are prioritized accordingly. This involvement enables proper identification of opportunities for improvement and development and mitigates risks and potential issues. Team Leads will tactically reassign projects or tasks between members of their team to meet deadlines as needed.

This role is designed for those that have experience in:

  • Project management
  • A strong foundation in strategic planning
  • Client facing experience in wealth management
  • People management
  • Leading and developing teams
  • Managing complex workloads

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Managing day-to-day team operations, ensuring tasks and projects are appropriately prioritized and executed in a timely manner
  • Help with resource planning, workflow management, and prioritization of teamwide initiatives
  • Identifying opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency
  • Work with internal teams to promote and launch firmwide initiatives
  • Assigning projects or responsibilities as needed to meet deadlines, balance workloads, and address evolving business needs
  • Interacting with Associates and Senior Associates to support all aspects of client servicing needs:
    • Escalate client items, assist TM in managing follow up communication, managing team members workload, ongoing client projects, and conducting quarterly performance reviews
  • Management and training of junior team members to promote individual and team growth
  • Management of associates and senior associates on the HR side:
    • Approving time off, leading mid-year and year-end reviews, hiring and interviewing new team members

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of wealth management experience
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail
  • Exceptional written and verbal communications skills
  • Ability to think critically, anticipate issues and prioritize multiple projects
  • Familiarity with operational aspects of business (new account openings, disbursements, etc.)
  • Exceptional relationship building skills both inside and outside of the organization
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, high-volume, high-pressure environment
  • Experience with Salesforce is a plus
  • Experience with Fidelity Investments is a plus
  • “No task is too small” mentality
  • Bachelor’s degree is required

Compensation

The total compensation range for this role, inclusive of base salary and bonus, is $135,000-$175,000, depending on skills and experience.

drawn.title: Investment & Corporate Banking - Industrials & Diversified Industries, Analyst
drawn.body:
Investment & Corporate Banking Analysts are directly involved in the design, origination, structuring and execution of mergers & acquisitions, financial advisory, global capital markets, financial risk management, structured & syndicated finance, and other global products and services for existing and prospective clients. An Analyst is expected to understand the implications, identify key industry and product trends and provide input on pitch and deal material to enhance the ultimate deliverable.

Analysts are assigned to a variety of projects and are given a broad range of responsibilities, some of which include:

• Conduct extensive quantitative economic, industry and company research and analysis
• Draft and prepare pitch books with detailed industry materials for multiple Industrials sub-sectors
• Conduct and model a broad range of corporate finance alternatives and due diligence for client transactions including M&A, strategic alternatives, capital structure development, acquisition finance and syndicated loan and capital market financing
• Evaluate risk/return parameters of financing transactions
• Financial modeling, valuation, comparable & relative value analyses and market-specific analysis
• Facilitate and coordinate product group idea generation and solutions development across a broad platform of global capabilities
• Draft client pitches and marketing materials including M&A, syndicated bank financing, public/private debt & equity capital markets, and other internal documentation by coordinating internal and external resources
• Assist in financing structuring, underwriting transaction evaluation, preparation, due diligence and execution
• Assist in the development and continued cultivation of client relationships

Qualifications:

• Bachelors degree in Finance or Economics and a minimum of 1 years investment banking, corporate finance, and capital markets experience with a top tier global bank
• Strong interest and understanding of the Industrials industry; experience with banking transactions related to the Industrials industry is a huge plus
• Knowledge of corporate finance, securities, financial markets and risk & pricing analysis
• Ideally will have experience in the general industrials sector
• Aptitude to synthesize large amounts of information and develop innovative ideas and/or product solutions
• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
• Ability to work under pressure and adhere to tight deadlines
• Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to convey ideas
• Creativity and intellectual curiosity
• Ability to work independently and must be able to work effectively in a team environment
• Proficiency with FactSet, CapitalIQ, Bloomberg, Microsoft Office
• Series 79 & 63

NOTE: This Job Description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with this job. Additionally, the contents of this Job Description may be modified or expanded by the Bank over time.

The expected base salary ranges from $110K - $130k. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Mizuho does not sponsor applicants for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, any sponsorship or administrative assistance or execution of any documentation related to F-1 (CPT/OPT/STEM OPT), TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1 or H-1B application.

drawn.title: Employee Benefits Consultant - ACA Reporting
drawn.body:
Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.
Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Position Overview
We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Benefits Consultant to join our growing team. This position will support a variety of employee benefits consulting engagements while developing expertise in benefits compliance, data analysis, and client service.

A significant component of this role will be supporting the annual preparation of Affordable Care Act (ACA) Forms 1094 and 1095 for contracted Baker Tilly clients. The Benefits Consultant will work closely with clients and internal team members to gather and validate data, identify and resolve discrepancies, prepare required forms, and help ensure accurate and timely completion of annual ACA reporting requirements.

This position is well suited for an early-career professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, managing detailed processes, and providing high-quality service to clients.

Responsibilities
Benefits Consulting

• Support leadership and project teams on a variety of employee benefits consulting engagements.
• Assist with the collection, organization, review, and analysis of client benefits and employee data.
• Perform research and analysis related to employee benefits programs, compliance requirements, and industry practices.
• Prepare spreadsheets, analyses, client deliverables, presentations, and other project materials.
• Assist with recurring and special client projects, maintaining project schedules and helping ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
• Communicate with clients and internal team members to obtain information, resolve questions, and support project completion.
• Develop knowledge of employee benefit programs and applicable federal and state compliance requirements.
Affordable Care Act Reporting

• Play a key role in the team's annual ACA reporting process, including preparation of Forms 1094-B/C and 1095-B/C for contracted Baker Tilly clients.
• Coordinate with clients to obtain employee, eligibility, enrollment, payroll, and other information necessary to complete ACA reporting.
• Review and validate client-provided data for completeness and consistency and identify potential discrepancies requiring additional investigation.
• Assist with data imports, reconciliation, coding, and preparation of ACA reporting files and forms.
• Work with clients and senior team members to research and resolve data and reporting issues.
• Perform quality-control reviews to support accurate and timely preparation of client filings.
• Track client deliverables, outstanding information, and filing deadlines throughout the annual reporting cycle.
• Assist with corrections and other follow-up activities associated with ACA reporting.
• Maintain organized documentation and appropriately handle confidential employee and benefits information.
• Stay informed of changes to ACA reporting requirements, deadlines, and related guidance.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in business, human resources, economics, data analytics, or a related field preferred.
• One (1) plus years of relevant professional experience are encouraged to apply.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with an ability to identify inconsistencies in large or complex data sets.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and an interest in developing advanced spreadsheet and data-analysis skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to learn new systems, regulations, and technical concepts quickly.
• Demonstrated commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, and high-quality client service.
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous internship or professional experience in employee benefits, human resources, payroll, accounting, tax, compliance, consulting, or a related field.
• Experience working with large data sets, including data reconciliation and validation.
• Familiarity with employee benefits or Affordable Care Act employer reporting requirements.
• Experience with Excel functions such as lookups, pivot tables, formulas, and data manipulation.

The pay rate range for this job position is $51,200 to $100,680. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Your work schedule will be Monday to Friday during regular office or site hours. At times, operational needs may require work outside these hours, with reasonable notice provided. All schedule or on-call adjustments will comply with applicable employment standards legislation. It is mandatory for all employees to complete a Criminal Background check and successfully attain a Restricted Access Identity Card (RAIC) upon joining the company. DESIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, COMPETENCIES Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience Minimum of 7 years of experience in BIM management or related digital delivery roles within the construction industry Strong experience developing and implementing BIM standards, workflows, and coordination protocols Proficiency with BIM and digital construction tools such as Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, Civil 3D, ACC, or similar platforms Experience managing Common Data Environments (CDEs) and supporting digital model governance Strong understanding of model audits, clash detection, coordination workflows, and model quality assurance Ability to support data extraction and reporting for project coordination, planning, and digital delivery objectives Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex project environment Experience in large-scale infrastructure, aviation, transit, or major capital project environments is considered an asset Must be eligible to obtain and maintain Restricted Access Identity Card (RAIC) clearance PACT is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. We are committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free candidate experience and work environment. If you require accommodation to apply or if selected to participate in an assessment process, please advise Human Resources.

Job Summary
We’re seeking a highly motivated and client-focused Japanese speaking Marketing Officer to support and manage a portfolio of Japanese multinational and international corporate clients. Serving as a key partner to Relationship Managers, this role is responsible for the day-to-day execution of corporate banking activities, including loan and deposit product onboarding, client servicing, transaction coordination, regulatory compliance support, and cross-border relationship management.
The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders across MUFG's global network, including product partners in the U.S., headquarters in Japan, and international offices worldwide, ensuring seamless delivery of banking solutions and exceptional client service. This position requires knowledge of corporate banking operations, excellent organizational and communication skills, and the ability to navigate a complex international banking environment while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory and compliance standards.

Major Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with various internal parties and face customers to conduct daily corporate banking operations, including the boarding of loan and deposit products, in line with various bank policies and procedures under the general guidelines provided by the Relationship Manager (RM). (Internal parties include the Product Office in the U.S., Headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, and MUFG’s other offices/branches all over the world.)
• Support RMs on administrative tasks and internal or client inquiries, such as regulatory reporting, documentation preparation and circulation, and business trip or client meeting arrangements.
• Create or maintain procedures / manuals related to the team.
• Assist with duties or inquiries related to compliance matters. Ensure adherence to all bank policies and procedures related to regulatory compliance as required.
• Perform and coordinate other duties and projects as assigned by Department Head, Team Manager or RMs.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business / Finance / Economics required.
• Minimum 1 year of banking experience in U.S. and international marketplace is required. 3 years preferred
• Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
• Excellent oral and written communications skills including excellent business writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
• Knowledge of domestic and foreign financial markets and products, including non-banking financial institutions, is preferred.
• Bilingual in Japanese and English is required.

Line of Business:
Personal & Commercial Banking Job Description:
The Premier Banker is an experienced banker, servicing as the primary contact for a complex client portfolio of mass affluent clients. Through proactive outreach, this role manages mass affluent clients' complete banking relationship and connects clients to specialists to ensure all financial needs are met. The objective of the role is to grow, deepen, and retain client relationships by delivering TD’s model of convenience, sales, and advice, and differentiating with a personalized, connected experience. Premier Bankers play a critical role in delivering TD's mass affluent premier value, building lasting relationships and providing legendary service to a valued set of clients.

Depth & Scope:

• Works in a bank location and will be accountable to grow, deepen, and retain strong relationships with a mass affluent book of business by proactively managing and addressing their banking needs with an advice-based approach
• Demonstrates proficiency and in-depth knowledge in banking and credit products, offerings, and processes to fluently explain banking solutions to a client and to act as an experienced liaison with internal partners in small business, wealth, commercial and lending
• Acquires, retains and deepens relationships with new mass affluent clients by converting referrals, leads, and outbound prospecting
• Proactively engages in client outreach (via phone, email, appointments, and other means) and regularly meets with clients to conduct needs-based conversations, review and analyze financial information, suggest appropriate solutions and/or service options, and coordinate introductions/interactions with appropriate partners
• Delivers excellent client service, reviews moderately complex clients concerns, and escalates banking related issues/risks when appropriate
• Adheres to all relevant Retail/Wealth policies, procedures, FINRA and regulatory banking requirements
• Engages in conversations with clients about loan products; facilitates the application intake. Must maintain an active registration status with NMLS (Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry)
• Establishes and maintains strong working relationships with partners via ongoing meetings and collaboration to identify areas for relationship deepening in Wealth, Commercial, Small Business, Lending, etc.
• Partners regularly with the Wealth Financial Advisor including warm referrals and joint pipeline and joint pipeline review meetings to prepare for future client interactions.
• Provides ongoing coaching and ongoing feedback to bank staff on effective methods to articulate the program's value and make Premier referrals for mass affluent clients

Education & Experience:

• HS Diploma or GED (required)

• 2+ years financial / banking experience
• Successful completion of the Securities Industry Essentials Exam (SIE) strongly preferred
• Life & Health license preferred
• Understanding and experience with retail and small business banking; experience interacting with Mass Affluent and high net worth clients
• Must maintain an active registration status with NMLS (Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry) upon hire
• Consultative sales experience required

• Delivers the TD Premier program to eligible Clients
• Knowledgeable in products and services to be able act as an educator and advisor to clients
• Requires established client service skills to perform a broad range of both routine and multi-step Customer transactions

• Utilizes client relationship tools to engage in needs-based conversations to identify solutions and provide proactive advice
• Understands client's banking preferences with banking and educates clients & non- clients on current promotions and campaigns as well as tools and resources to make banking easier for the client
• Understands and supports the Bank's Customer Service Strategy
• Delivers client end-to-end advice they expect: (1) building trust with educational content & tools, (2) providing consultative support, and (3) advocating for them with proactive insights & recommendations
• Considers the impact of decisions on the well-being of TD, its clients, and stakeholders
• Provides the highest level of client service when dealing with internal partners or vendors
• Works as a single point of contact to clients by exploring various products or services and connecting the client with partners as needed

• Ensures documentation that is prepared / completed is accurate and properly reflects client/ business intentions and is consistent with relevant rules / regulations
• Applies Compliance policies and regulations to all transactions to ensure integrity of proper compliance with all documentation that operational requirements are followed and that the appropriate documentation is recorded
• Engages in conversations with clients regarding loan applications, prepares documents, and conducts loan closings

Job Description:

At Piper Sandler, we connect capital with opportunity to build a better future.

We believe that diverse teams with unique backgrounds, skills and experiences yield more innovative solutions. This is reflected in our commitment to engage, hire, and retain bright, committed people to work in partnership within an inclusive environment that allows each person to achieve personal success and add value to our teams and communities.

We are currently looking for an Investment Banking Associate to join our Upstream team in the Houston, TX office. Learn more about the Energy & Power group here .

Our associate position offers a unique opportunity for ambitious professionals seeking to play a meaningful role in our continued growth while gaining significant experience in M&A, debt, equity and equity-linked transactions. The associate will prepare valuations, write memorandums for company sale assignments and private placements, prepare M&A analyses, and participate in due diligence and drafting sessions for public offerings. The associate is responsible for structuring and executing transactions, and typically functions as a backup for relationships with important clients, is generally the key contact for some clients, and begins to assume some important new business responsibilities.

Attracting only the very best professionals has been and will continue to be a key element of our success. We are focused on hiring candidates with genuine potential and interest for advancement within our firm. A successful candidate will possess the following characteristics:

• 3 years of experience involving financial analysis, transaction execution or related
• Experience in investment banking, private equity, or oil and gas is beneficial

Job Description:

At Baker Tilly, we invest in our people. We believe in continuous learning and development and have several programs to ensure the success of our people. As we continue to grow our Transaction Advisory Services practice, we are seeking to add an Analyst to join our team. Our clients include privately held and publicly traded companies, private equity funds, mezzanine funds, banks, private debt funds, and business development companies. This multi-faceted client base allows us to provide our staff with a variety of opportunities across numerous industries, and a constant flow of challenging and meaningful work.

What You Will Do:

• Interact directly with Partners on matters related to client and engagement management.
• Data gathering, document review and preparation of quality of earnings reports.

Qualifications

• Excellent organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to multitask and handle multiple priorities appropriately
• Ability to work autonomously, to meet tight deadlines, and to thrive in a fast paced
environment with shifting priorities
• Excellent verbal and written communication, experience presenting analyses to
management and ability to lead and drive initiatives
• Ability to work effectively and thrive in a team environment with all levels of client personnel in various industries
• Ability to comfortably interact with senior level client personnel, including supporting the preparation of and participating in executive briefings

drawn.body:
Department: Global Transaction Banking Division Americas
Function: Sales - BA Sales

General Department Description
Global Transaction Banking Division Americas provides transaction banking solutions across payments and collections, cash and liquidity management, trade finance, supply chain finance, commercial card, receivables finance, and related treasury capabilities. The division serves corporate clients across the Americas and works closely with Coverage, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Mizuho’s global network.

Summary
The Associate, BA Sales supports origination and execution across Banking Americas clients by preparing client and industry analysis, developing proposals and RFP responses, maintaining pipeline and call records, coordinating opportunity actions, and supporting handoff to Product, Onboarding, Execution & Delivery and Client Experience. The role participates in the cross-functional assignment model to build broad product, client and execution capability.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

• Sales Support: Prepare client research, treasury and working-capital analysis, opportunity briefs, presentation materials, proposals and RFP responses for assigned BA opportunities.
• Opportunity Execution: Coordinate action plans, pricing inputs, internal approvals, documentation requests and handoffs across Sales, Product, Relationship Management, Credit, Legal, Onboarding and Client Experience.
• Client and Stakeholder Support: Participate in client meetings as assigned, prepare agendas and materials, and circulate accurate follow-up actions within agreed timelines.
• Pipeline and Data Quality: Maintain complete and timely pipeline, client activity, revenue and milestone data; reconcile exceptions and escalate gaps before reporting deadlines.
• Risk and Controls: Follow applicable policies, procedures, approval standards and information-handling requirements; support timely remediation of assigned control items.
• Cross-Functional Development: Maintain current assignment and capacity information, execute a balanced mix of assignments, escalate workload conflicts early, seek feedback, and contribute reusable materials.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree required; finance, business, economics, or a related field preferred.
• Professional Experience: Two to five years of relevant experience in transaction banking, treasury services, corporate banking, financial analysis, or sales support.
• Technical Knowledge: Working knowledge of cash management and trade finance products, financial analysis, pipeline reporting, and presentation development.
• Skills: Strong analytical, organizational, writing, and presentation skills; proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; ability to manage multiple deadlines.
• Language: English required. Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language is a plus.
• Travel: Limited, based on client and business needs.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a global bank or corporate treasury environment; exposure to client analytics, RFPs, cash management, or trade finance; CTP coursework or other relevant professional development.

Work Location
In-office presence is an essential function of this role, and this role requires work from the office five days per week. Remote work may be used on an as-needed and ad hoc basis in accordance with applicable Banking policies.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Mizuho does not sponsor applicants for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes, but is not limited to, any sponsorship or administrative assistance or execution of any documentation related to F-1 (CPT/OPT/STEM OPT), TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1 or H-1B application.

drawn.title: Data Analytics
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE GROUP

The Internal Audit Department Americas (IADA) provides internal audit services to the branches, representative offices and agencies of Mizuho Bank, Ltd. in the Americas, and to Mizuho Bank (USA). IADA’s mission is to act as an independent, objective assurance and consulting function, designed to add value and improve Mizuho Bank’s U.S. operations including the derivatives and broker dealer businesses. Based in the New York Metro area, IADA staff members perform various audits of different business areas of the bank to evaluate the effectiveness of risk management and governance processes. Along with its counterparts in London, Hong Kong and Singapore, IADA reports to and composes the overseas arm of MHBK’s Internal Audit Division (IAD).

Data Analytics Function’s Coverage Summary
Execute the Group’s IADA Data Analytics program, including fulfilling the day-to-day analytics needs of the IADA teams as well identifying additional opportunities to leverage data analytics to optimize internal audit quality, coverage and cost. This individual will identify, design, develop, and maintain the data analytics routines needed to support audit activities including audit execution, continuous monitoring, and department level management and reporting.

DETAILS OF JOB DESCRIPTION
Under the direction of the Head of Data Analytics, lead the execution of the IADA Data Analytics program. Translate strategic objectives into executable plans, deliverables, and timelines across audit execution, continuous monitoring, and departmental reporting.

Design, develop, and maintain audit analytics routines that support audit planning, executions, and continuous auditing. Ensure analytics enable increased testing coverage, full-population testing, and identification of outliers, anomalies, patterns, and trends to evaluate control design and operating effectiveness.

Drive operational effectiveness and consistency of analytics usage across audits by establishing standard methodologies, reusable analytics assets, and execution playbooks aligned with Internal Audit standards and regulatory expectations.

Oversee data extraction, transformation, and preparation activities to support audit analytics, working closely with Technology and Business partners to obtain reliable, timely, and well-controlled data inputs.

Manage and enhance analytics infrastructure and tools used by the IADA team, ensuring solutions are scalable, well-documented, and fit for audit use.

Develop and implement automated testing and continuous monitoring solutions under the direction of the Head of Data Analytics, expanding the use of analytics to improve audit efficiency, coverage, and timeliness.

Act as a primary point of contact for audit teams and business partners on analytics-related matters, including data sourcing, interpretation of results, and integration of analytics into audit programs.

Provide technical leadership and quality review over analytics-supported audit testing, including reviewing workpapers, validating methodologies, assessing test results, and supporting conclusions regarding control design and operating effectiveness.

Lead execution of complex analytics initiatives and special projects, including regulatory-driven analytics, enterprise data efforts, and cross-audit analytics programs, as assigned by the Head of Data Analytics.

T rack, analyze, and report on program-level metrics related to analytics adoption, effectiveness, and efficiency. Prepare management-level dashboards and narratives to support Internal Audit leadership reporting.

Direct, coach, and develop IADA Data Analytics staff, including assigning work, reviewing performance, providing feedback, and supporting ongoing professional development for junior staff.

Foundational understanding AI and advanced analytics concepts, including exposure to machine learning, generative AI, and automation capabilities, and an understanding of how such tools may be applied within Internal Audit. Experience applying or piloting such techniques in an audit, risk, or analytics context is a plus but not required.

LIST OF CORE COMPETENCIES
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in business, mathematics, computer science, management information systems, or a related field. Advanced degree and/or professional certifications (e.g., MBA, CPA, CIA, CISA, CFE, or equivalent) preferred.

Significant experience (10-15+ years) in internal audit, external audit, regulatory examination, or risk management within financial services, including demonstrated experience leading teams or workstreams.

Strong hands-on expertise in audit data analytics, including full-population testing, anomaly detection, trend analysis, and analytics-enabled control testing.

Demonstrates strong knowledge and proficiency in data extraction, transformation, and analytics tools, with demonstrated experience leveraging a wide variety of data analysis tools:

• Database Management: Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, Snowflake, Sybase

• Analytics Tools: SQL, Python, PySpark, SparkSQL

• Reporting and Visualization Tools: PowerBI, Tableau, QlikView

• Data Integration and ETL Tools: Azure (Azure Data Factory, ADLS), Databricks, Airflow, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

• Data Automation and Scheduling Tools: Tidal

Experience implementing and operating continuous auditing and monitoring programs, including automation of recurring tests and exception reporting.
Solid understanding of audit methodology, internal controls, and audit documentation standards, with the ability to integrate analytics into audit workpapers and conclusions.
Experience in banking, capital markets, treasury, risk management (credit, market, liquidity and operational), audit, finance with knowledge of risks and controls within Capital Markets.

drawn.body:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

About the Role

Position Title: Murex Support Analyst
Corporate Title: Analyst
Reporting to: VP
Location: Bengaluru

Job Profile
The role provides day-to-day functional and technical support for the Murex platform within the Enterprise Trading Platforms organisation. Operating as a key point of contact for business and Technology stakeholders, the role supports production stability, investigates incidents and service requests, and helps maintain the effective operation of Murex across Front Office, Risk, Product Control, Operations and Finance processes.

The scope covers front-to-back production support across multiple asset classes and MUFG entities, including trade capture, lifecycle processing, market data, valuations, risk outputs, interfaces, batch processing, confirmations and settlements. The role works closely with senior support analysts, development teams, infrastructure teams and external vendors to diagnose issues, coordinate resolution and reduce operational disruption.

The role reports to the Head of Murex Technology and forms part of the wider Murex Technology support function. It requires close collaboration with users and partner teams to ensure incidents are prioritised appropriately, communications remain clear and the platform operates in a safe, controlled and resilient manner

Qualifications:

• Bachelor/master’s degree in information technology, computer science or a closely related discipline, or an equivalent combination of formal education and experience.
• Minimum 3-8 years of software development experience

Job Responsibilities:
· Provide day-to-day production support for the Murex platform, responding to incidents, service requests and user queries in line with agreed priorities and service expectations.
· Investigate issues across trade capture, lifecycle events, market data, pricing inputs, valuations, sensitivities, confirmations, settlements, interfaces and batch processes, working with relevant teams to determine root cause and restore service.
· Act as a technology partner to Front Office, Risk, Product Control, Operations and Finance users, providing clear communication on issue status, business impact, workarounds and resolution progress.
· Monitor application health, overnight and intraday processing, interfaces and operational controls, proactively identifying failed or delayed processes and initiating appropriate recovery actions.
· Record incidents and service requests accurately, maintaining clear audit trails, investigation notes, ownership, actions and closure evidence within the relevant service management tools.
· Escalate complex functional or technical issues to senior support analysts, Murex development, infrastructure teams, external vendors or other system owners, and coordinate activities through to resolution.
· Support root-cause analysis and problem management for recurring incidents, contributing to permanent fixes and improvements that reduce operational risk and manual intervention.
· Participate in release, upgrade and change activities, including impact assessment, functional testing, regression testing, implementation support and post-release validation.
· Maintain support procedures, knowledge articles, operational runbooks and team documentation, ensuring information is current, accurate and accessible.
· Contribute to service reporting, incident trend analysis and continuous improvement initiatives across the Murex Technology function.

• Operate with a strong risk and controls mindset, complying with change, incident, access, audit, cybersecurity and operational risk requirements

Required Experience and Skills
· Experience in an application support, production support or technology operations role within Capital Markets, Investment Banking or a comparable financial services environment.
· Working knowledge of the Murex platform, or demonstrable experience supporting a comparable front-to-back trading and risk management system.
· Good understanding of derivative products, trade booking models and lifecycle events across one or more of Rates, Credit, Equity or FX.
· Understanding of front-to-back business processes, including trade capture, position management, valuations, risk, confirmations and settlements.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues methodically across functional and technical components.
· Working knowledge of SQL, application logs, batch processing and system interfaces; familiarity with technologies such as JMS, MQ, JSON or XML would be beneficial.
· Understanding of incident management, service management and production support disciplines, with the ability to maintain accurate records and follow controlled processes.
· Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to explain issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Awareness of operational risk, information security, audit and regulatory considerations relevant to trading technology platforms

Personal Requirements:
· Demonstrates a proactive and service-focused approach, taking ownership of issues and maintaining momentum through to resolution.
· Exhibits strong analytical ability, curiosity and attention to detail when diagnosing complex or time-sensitive production problems.
· Communicates clearly and professionally, providing concise and accurate updates to users, colleagues and stakeholders.
· Works effectively as part of a distributed team and collaborates constructively across business, support, development and infrastructure functions.
· Operates calmly under pressure, applying sound prioritisation and judgement during business-critical incidents.
· Demonstrates a willingness to learn, build Murex functional and technical expertise, and share knowledge with colleagues.
· Maintains strong personal accountability, accuracy and discipline in the execution of support activities.

• Applies a strong risk and controls mindset, ensuring work is performed safely, consistently and in accordance with established procedures

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

drawn.title: Junior Conflicts Analyst
drawn.body:
We Do Consulting Differently

Summary

This full-time position, reporting to the Sr. Conflicts Manager and ultimately to the Conflicts Counsel, offers the opportunity to become a valued member of BRG's dynamic legal team. The role is based out of BRG’s Chicago, DC, or New York office, with a hybrid schedule requiring in-office presence three days per week. As an hourly position, it is eligible for overtime compensation.

Responsibilities
- Research corporate affiliations of clients and parties using Capital IQ and/or Hoover's/D&B as well as cross-reference information using the internet.
- Perform routine conflicts of interest searches in Intapp by identifying and validating party information; determining appropriate search criteria
(Boolean operators); running searches and analyzing results for data to be included or excluded based on the policies and procedures of the General
Counsel's Office.
-Verify that all conflicts reports are complete, consistent, accurate, and adhere to established standards and procedures for all conflicts of interest
searches performed firm-wide.
- Assist and respond to the legal team and conflicts manager.
- Assist in maintaining data in Intapp by updating client/matter name changes and adding parties to existing matters.
- Uphold standards for searching and analyses on all requests by implementing and policing standards of accuracy, quality, and thoroughness.
- Be available for urgent and confidential matters and situations, including evenings and weekends.
- Contribute to process, procedure, and technology improvements to provide optimum customer service and efficiency.
- Exhibit proficiency in the understanding and utilization of the conflicts database; including maintenance and updating of the database.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree is required.
- One to three years of experience in risk management, research, reference library work, conflict searching, or related experience is preferred.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Intapp, Elite, Hoover's/D&B, research software and iManage.
- Strict attention to detail and excellent analytical and organizational skills are a must.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
-Must be responsible for completing tasks and following through with the resolution of issues, including the ability to meet deadlines and work in a
fast-paced environment.
- The ideal candidate must interact well with people at all levels with a high degree of accuracy, confidentiality, poise, and professionalism.
- Strong understanding of conflicts-of-interest and business intake procedures in a law firm or professional services environment is preferred.
- Conflicts training will be provided.

Salary Range: $60,000-$75,000

Candidate must be able to submit verification of his/her legal right to work in the United States, without company sponsorship.

About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.

BRG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our hiring practices provide equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender, national origin, age, United States military veteran status, ancestry, sexual orientation, marital status, family structure, medical condition including genetic characteristics or information, veteran status, or mental or physical disability so long as the essential functions of the job can be performed with or without reasonable accommodation, or any other protected category under federal, state, or local law.

drawn.body:
Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.
Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

The Senior Manager, Technology Enablement is a senior business-facing technology leader responsible for helping Consulting and Managed Services use technology effectively to improve growth, scalability, efficiency, client delivery, and business performance. This role develops a deep understanding of the businesses supported and translates business needs into clear technology recommendations and roadmaps, with a core focus on using existing enterprise capabilities, third-party platforms, and commercial software effectively and ensuring technology investments deliver meaningful value.\

Essential Job Functions, Responsibilities & Duties:

1. Serve as a strategic technology advisor
• Build trusted relationships with business and practice leaders and understand their strategies, operating models, workflows, economics, and technology needs.
• Identify opportunities where technology can improve business performance, scalability, quality, client experience, or risk management.
• Distinguish problems requiring technology investment from those better addressed through process, adoption, operating-model, or organizational changes.
• Turn complex business and technology considerations into clear options, recommendations, and actions; challenge assumptions and recommend a path forward.
• Partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, AI, Security, Operations, Procurement, Finance, Risk, and business leadership to establish ownership and decision rights and drive work to outcomes.
40%
2. Lead and develop the Technology Enablement team
• Lead and develop a team of 3-5 direct reports, setting clear expectations for business understanding, analytical rigor, judgment, communication, and accountability.
• Build independent, high-performing team members who bring recommendations and ownership rather than simply coordinating activity or reporting information.
• Create clear accountability, delegate effectively, coach decision-making, and address performance or ownership gaps promptly.
30%
3. Lead third-party technology and application portfolio strategy
• Own visibility into and stewardship of material third-party applications used across the supported service lines.
• Evaluate whether business needs should be addressed through existing enterprise capabilities, improved adoption or configuration, commercial software, or an internally developed solution.
• Evaluate software vendors and platforms based on business fit, capabilities, cost, risk, architecture, and strategic alignment.
• Drive recommendations regarding investment, expansion, consolidation, rationalization, replacement, and retirement, while improving value realization and reducing unnecessary cost and complexity.
15%
4. Shape technology roadmaps and investment priorities
• Develop service-line technology roadmaps aligned to business strategy and enterprise technology direction.
• Help leaders prioritize investments based on value, strategic alignment, cost, risk, complexity, readiness, and capacity.
• Connect initiatives across the portfolio to reduce duplication and fragmented technology decisions.
• Surface risks, dependencies, ownership gaps, and decisions early and drive them toward resolution.
15%

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree required; degree in technology, business, accounting, or a related field preferred. MBA preferred.
• 8 years of progressive experience in business technology, technology strategy, technology consulting, application portfolio management, enterprise/business applications, digital transformation, product management, or a related field required
• Experience translating business strategies and complex business problems into technology recommendations and actionable roadmaps; evaluating commercial software and vendors; and managing or advising on an application or technology portfolio, including investment and lifecycle decisions. Experience in professional services, financial services, healthcare, or similarly complex industries preferred.
• Strong business and financial judgment with the ability to evaluate value, cost, risk, tradeoffs, and strategic alignment; understanding of complex, technology-dependent business environments.

drawn.title: Risk Manager (Construction)
drawn.body: PACT (Pearson Accelerator Construction Team) is a General Partnership of Alberici, Amico, Kenaidan, and Obayashi, supported by design partners Egis, Mott MacDonald, and Weston Williamson + Partners. Together, we are delivering Accelerator, a major program of Pearson LIFT (Long-term Investment in Facilities and Terminals), Toronto Pearson's infrastructure development plan. This multi-year program is designed to address immediate passenger growth demands while preparing Canada’s largest airport for the future of air travel—including critical upgrades to airfield and infrastructure, greenhouse gas reduction initiatives, modernization of Terminals 1 and 3, and the creation of a world-class passenger experience. JOB SUMMARY The Risk Manager plays a critical role in supporting the successful delivery of construction projects by identifying, assessing, and managing project risks throughout the PACT project lifecycle. This position works closely with project managers, estimators, health and safety teams, and senior leadership to ensure proactive risk mitigation strategies are in place, enabling informed decision‑making and enhancing project performance. RESPONSIBILITIES Manage sub-program and project risk registers, maintaining an up-to-date record of identified risks and their mitigation strategies. Qualitative and quantitative risk analysis. Collaborate closely with the sub-program team to facilitate joint risk evaluation, fostering a culture of shared responsibility in identifying and addressing potential risks. Provide valuable input to the QCRA/QSRA process, contributing insights to inform target price and schedule decisions. Develop and implement strategies to proactively manage and mitigate risks throughout all phases of the project. Ensure compliance with risk management standards and procedures and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Support with other duties as needed. WORKING CONDITIONS The position will be based at our office in Mississauga, Ontario, with visits to the Airport site as required. Your work schedule will be Monday to Friday during regular office or site hours. At times, operational needs may require work outside these hours, with reasonable notice provided. All schedule or on call adjustments will comply with applicable employment standards legislation. It is mandatory for all employees to complete a Criminal Background Check and successfully attain a Restricted Access Identity Card (RAIC) upon joining the company. DESIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, COMPETENCIES Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Risk Management, Finance, Business, or a related discipline. A Master’s degree in a relevant field is considered an asset. Professional designation or certification, such as P.Eng., PMP, PMI-RMP, AACE certification, CRM, or an equivalent recognized project/risk management qualification is preferred. Comparable current senior roles also identify certifications such as PMI-RMP, AACE and PMP as advantageous. Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in project/program risk management, project controls, or the delivery of major capital projects, preferably within large-scale infrastructure, transportation, aviation, or complex construction environments. Demonstrated experience implementing and supporting project and program risk management frameworks throughout the project lifecycle, including risk identification, assessment, response planning, monitoring, reporting, and escalation. Strong experience developing, maintaining, and assuring project and program risk registers, including the identification and assessment of threats and opportunities, assignment of risk ownership, development of mitigation strategies, monitoring of actions, and assessment of residual risk. Demonstrated experience planning and facilitating risk identification workshops, risk reviews, interviews, and collaborative risk sessions involving multidisciplinary teams, contractors, consultants, clients, and senior stakeholders. Excellent facilitation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, contractors, project leadership, executives, and other internal and external stakeholders. Ability to communicate complex technical and risk information clearly and concisely through risk reports, dashboards, presentations, and executive-level briefings. Strong practical experience conducting Qualitative and Quantitative Risk Analysis, including Quantitative Cost Risk Analysis (QCRA) and Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA), preferably using Monte Carlo simulation and other recognized risk-modelling techniques. Advanced proficiency with risk management and quantitative risk-analysis software, such as Safran Risk Manager, Safran Risk Analyzer, Primavera Risk Analysis (PRA), @RISK, or equivalent platforms. Ability to interpret quantitative risk-analysis results and translate complex risk information into clear, practical and actionable insights that support contingency development, management decision-making, and project delivery. Demonstrated understanding of the integration between risk management and other project controls disciplines, including cost management, scheduling, estimating, change management, commercial management, forecasting, and performance reporting. Solid understanding of construction and infrastructure project delivery, including experience with collaborative and progressive delivery models. Experience with Progressive Design-Build, Design-Build, P3, Alliance/IPD, CMAR, or similar alternative delivery models is considered an asset. Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving capabilities, with demonstrated ability to identify emerging risks, challenge assumptions, evaluate uncertainty, and recommend appropriate risk-response strategies. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary project environment, while also exercising independent judgement, initiative, and accountability. Experience supporting or delivering major infrastructure or aviation programs is strongly preferred. Experience working within highly regulated, operationally complex, or safety-critical environments is also considered an asset. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with Power BI, Primavera P6, or other project-controls/data-visualization platforms is considered an asset. PACT is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. We are committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free candidate experience and work environment. If you require accommodation to apply or if selected to participate in an assessment process, please advise Human Resources.

Modera Wealth Management is an independent, fee-only firm that strives to make a lasting positive impact on the lives of our clients through comprehensive financial planning and intelligent investment management. Modera is fast-growing and has a track record of providing career development opportunities from entry level to ownership.

Through this vision, we have grown to more than 200 employees in 19 offices along the East Coast, managing more than $15B in assets for more than 6,000 individuals, families, and businesses.

We are looking for a Financial Advisor in Westwood, MA that is responsible for developing and deepening relationships with an established base of clients to deliver a world class experience.

Investment Banking Business – Snowflake Migration Projects

Responsibilities will include project planning and execution, recommending solutions to project challenges, identifying and mitigating risks, prioritizing deliverables, managing timelines, and working with cross-functional teams. You will independently manage the execution of projects, identify and mitigate risks, address issues, coordinate resources, and contribute to documentation and reporting efforts.
Ideal candidates possess strong organizational skills, familiarity with cloud data solutions (preferably Snowflake), and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Previous experience in financial services or technology project coordination is desirable.

• Plan and execute Snowflake migration projects
• Resolve project issues, assess associated risks and impacts, manage resource constraints, and recommend and implement the most appropriate course of action to support project success and meet project deadlines
• Manage project milestones and deliverables, providing regular status updates
• Maintain project documentation, schedules, and meeting notes
• Coordinate with technical and business teams and among stakeholders to ensure alignment
• Contribute to post-migration reviews and continuous improvement efforts

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field
• Certifications: PMP certified
• Experience or coursework in project management or technology coordination
• Understanding of cloud data platforms and migration processes (Datawarehouse and/or datalake experience preferred)
• Excellent communication and organizational skills
• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
• Awareness of investment banking technology and data solutions would be an advantage, specifically DCM, ECM, M&A/Advisory or Corporate Finance business lines.

The expected base salary ranges from $83k-$120k. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

#LI-Hybrid

Mizuho has in place a hybrid working program, with varying opportunities for remote work depending on the nature of the role, needs of your department, as well as local laws and regulatory obligations. · Support the weekly/monthly forecast and annual budget for FID and EQ

· Analyze direct and allocated expenses and support monthly cost reviews with business COOs
· Maintain reporting standards and data integrity for FID and EQ per HO (Japan) requirements
· Maintain hierarchies and mappings (desks, trading books, cost centers, entities) across systems
· Support monthly allocations and inter-entity reconciliations across Americas legal entities

· Respond to ad hoc requests from HO (Japan), LOB leads and Finance partners

· Experience supporting Fixed Income and/or Equities businesses in a finance role strongly preferred
· Working knowledge of FID and EQ products (e.g., rates, credit, securitized products, cash equities, derivatives) and their revenue/expense drivers
· Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with OneStream, Hyperion, Anaplan or PeopleSoft
· Understanding of income statement data across business line, desk, entity and head office reporting dimensions

· Clear communicator with strong problem-solving skills

drawn.body: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>COMPANY OVERVIEW:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Fisher\SMB, we are dedicated to guiding our clients through the complexities of retirement planning with expertise and care. Since our founding, we have specialized in providing retirement-focused financial strategies that support long-term security and sustainable growth. Our personalized approach combines in-depth market knowledge with a commitment to understanding each client’s unique financial goals.</p> <p>As part of our team, you’ll be joining a group of professionals driven by a shared mission: to deliver exceptional service, uphold ethical standards, and contribute to our clients’ financial well sent confidence. We believe in fostering an environment where innovation, collaboration, and professional development are encouraged. If you are passionate about helping others secure their future while advancing your career in a supportive setting, Fisher\SMB is the place for you.</p></div><p><strong>JOB SUMMARY:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Participant Engagement Associate helps hard-working Americans plan and save for a comfortable retirement. Through virtual one-on-one education meetings, we help our participants craft a plan for their retirement including establishing a savings and investment strategy, setting up their online account, and rolling over any prior retirement accounts.</p> <p><strong>JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Educate participants on saving and investing for retirement through one-on-one meetings <em>(*Both in English and Spanish).</em></li> <li>Support Retirement Counselors with campaign resource planning, coordination, and booking.</li> <li>Work with plan sponsors and participants on follow up items from one-on-one meetings, rolling over outside retirement accounts, and other service needs that arise.</li> <li>Lead many side responsibilities, projects, and new programs essential to our growth as a department.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage assigned team responsibilities.</li> <li>Ensure timely data entry of all client interactions.</li> <li>Support the development of team training materials.</li> <li>Participate in team meetings and contribute to strategy discussions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience</li> <li>Strong service-oriented mindset and will-do attitude.</li> <li>You meet challenges head-on; You learn from your setbacks and work towards improvement.</li> <li>You are engaging and can connect with a wide array of audiences by phone and email.</li> <li>Ability to travel for work on occasion.</li> <li><em>*Bi-lingual Spanish skills.</em></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>EMPLOYEE BENEFITS:</strong></p> <p>At Fisher\SMB™, we are dedicated to the health, well-being, and future of our employees. We offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Health Insurance</strong>: Medical, dental, and vision premiums are 100% covered by the company, with flexible plan options to meet diverse needs. Preventive care is fully covered, and employees have access to an extensive provider network.</li> <li><strong>Retirement Savings</strong>: Our retirement plan offers a 50% employer match for contributions up to IRS limits, along with flexible investment options to accommodate different risk preferences.</li> <li><strong>Additional Insurance</strong>: Company-sponsored life, AD&amp;D, short-term, and long-term disability insurance to provide peace of mind.</li> <li><strong>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</strong>: Confidential counseling and wellness support to help employees navigate life’s challenges.</li> <li><strong>Concierge Health Support</strong>: Access to "Ask Bennie," a dedicated healthcare concierge team to answer questions and provide guidance on health benefits.</li> <li><strong>Employee Perks and Discounts</strong>: Exclusive discounts on a range of services and products.</li> </ul> <p>Join us at Fisher\SMB™ and experience a supportive environment that values your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT:</strong></p> <p>Fisher\SMB is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.</p> <p>All employment decisions at Fisher\SMB are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply and are dedicated to providing a fair, respectful, and accessible hiring process for all. Reasonable accommodations are available to candidates with disabilities to support their participation in the application and interview process.</p> <p><strong>DISCLAIMER:</strong></p> <p>This job description provides a summary of typical responsibilities and qualifications for this position; however, it is not intended to be exhaustive or comprehensive. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as assigned, and responsibilities, duties, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. This document does not create a contract of employment or alter the at-will employment relationship of Fisher\SMB.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>
