drawn.title: Account Executive
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Account Executive on the sales team at a B2B construction technology startup, you'll own a European territory and manage mid-market sales from prospecting through close and account growth. You'll help traditional industries modernize their operations by bringing software solutions to businesses that often still rely on paper-based processes and spreadsheets.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and qualify pipeline through cold outreach, direct prospecting, trade shows, fairs, and industry meetups.

- Own the full sales cycle, from initial contact through C-level negotiations and deal close.

- Win mid-market accounts with 100 to 2,000 employees, targeting deal sizes of €25,000 to €40,000.

- Develop customer relationships after the initial sale and identify opportunities to expand and retain accounts.

- Partner with BDRs, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to improve pipeline velocity.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least 2 years of experience as an Account Executive in complex B2B SaaS sales, ideally in a fast-paced startup environment.

- A demonstrated record of closing deals in the €15,000 to €20,000 range and mid-market accounts.

- Experience independently building pipeline through cold outreach and applying MEDDPICC or a similar sales methodology.

- Fluency in spoken and written German and English.

- Experience selling to traditional European industries such as manufacturing, logistics, construction, or trade.

- A bachelor's degree from a strong university or equivalent, plus a record of strong performance against sales targets.

- Willingness to travel for customer meetings, trade shows, and industry events.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual on-target earnings are €120,000 to €160,000, with uncapped upside. Visa sponsorship is not available.

LOCATION

On-site in Munich, Bavaria, Germany.

drawn.title: Internal Audit - Liquidity Risk Management
drawn.body:
Audit Manager, Liquidity Risk Management AVP

About the Team
The Internal Audit Department Americas (IADA) is an independent and objective assurance and advisory function responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes across Mizuho's U.S. Operations (MUSO), including banking, broker-dealer, swap dealer, sales, and trading activities.

Based in New York City , IADA provides comprehensive audit coverage of key business functions and risk areas to help ensure regulatory compliance, operational effectiveness, and sound risk management practices.

Position Summary
The Audit Manager/Senior Audit Manager will be a key member of the Liquidity Risk Audit Team within IADA. This role is responsible for executing risk-based audits across liquidity, treasury, and capital management functions, providing independent assurance over the effectiveness of controls and governance processes. The successful candidate will partner with stakeholders across the organization, remain current on regulatory developments, and contribute to the continuous enhancement of the audit function.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute audits within the Liquidity Risk Management audit universe, including:

• Liquidity Risk Management

• Independent Liquidity Review Function

• Treasury Banking Functions

• Capital Management

• Independent Price Verification (IPV) Framework

• Perform audit activities across all phases of the audit lifecycle, including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and issue follow-up, in accordance with IADA methodology and professional standards.

• Adhere to established audit timelines, project plans, and departmental scheduling requirements.

• Support the Continuous Monitoring Program by assessing emerging risks, monitoring changes within the liquidity risk environment, and validating the remediation of audit issues.

• Collaborate with other Internal Audit teams to support integrated audits and provide subject matter expertise when required.

• Conduct special audits, regulatory reviews, investigations, and other ad hoc projects as assigned.

• Maintain knowledge of applicable banking regulations, supervisory expectations, and industry developments affecting liquidity, treasury, and capital management activities.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with business management, risk and control functions, external auditors, regulatory agencies, and audit colleagues.

• Support quality assurance initiatives and continuously promote adherence to audit standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Qualifications
Education & Certifications

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• Professional certifications such as CPA, CA, CIA, CISA, or equivalent are preferred.

Experience

• 5-7 years of relevant experience in internal audit, external audit, regulatory examination, risk management, or a related control function within the financial services industry.

• Experience auditing liquidity risk, treasury, capital management, market risk, or related banking functions is strongly preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

• Strong understanding of internal audit principles, standards, practices, and methodologies.

• Knowledge of risk management frameworks, internal controls, governance processes, and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Familiarity with key banking and securities regulations and the ability to assess associated risks and controls.

• Ability to independently plan and execute audits in accordance with professional auditing standards and organizational policies.

• Experience leveraging data analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools, or other technology solutions to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness.

• Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare high-quality audit documentation and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

• Proven project management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Attributes

• Strong understanding of liquidity risk management practices within a banking environment.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and functions.

• Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and staying current with evolving regulatory expectations and industry developments.

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality audit outcomes.

The expected base salary ranges from $107,000.00 - $160,000.00 Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, including but not limited to Medical, Dental and 401k that begin on day one of employment, successful candidates are also eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

#LI-Hybrid
#LI-NR1

Other requirements
Mizuho has in place a hybrid working program, with varying opportunities for remote work depending on the nature of the role, needs of your department, as well as local laws and regulatory obligations. drawn.title: Payroll Technician
drawn.body: Summary The Payroll Specialist supports payroll operations by accurately keying payroll data, maintaining payroll records, and assisting with payroll-related inquiries. The Payroll Specialist is a key contributor to ensuring payroll accuracy, providing compliance support, and delivering employee payroll services. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Process full payroll cycle for Canadian and US semi-monthly payroll accurately and on time, including earnings, deductions, adjustments, bonuses, reimbursements, taxable benefits, and other payroll-related entries. Review and validate payroll inputs, source documents, and employee payroll changes for completeness, accuracy, and proper approval before payroll deadlines, including direct deposit, tax forms, garnishments, benefit deductions, compensation updates, and employment status changes. Coordinate with external providers during the monthly international payroll process, including providing employee changes, leave calculations, calendars, and required country-specific payroll supporting documentation. Assist with expatriate and cross-border payroll administration, including coordination of travel calendars, shadow payroll inputs, hypo tax adjustments, and year-end payroll adjustments. Coordinate with Human Resources to resolve payroll data issues, missing approvals, timekeeping discrepancies, and employee record updates. Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documentation in accordance with company policies, audit requirements, and applicable payroll regulations. Respond to employee payroll inquiries related to pay statements, deductions, direct deposit, tax withholding, benefits, and payment timing; escalate complex issues to HR/Payroll Manager and/or Accounting Manager as needed. Support payroll compliance activities, including routine payroll audits, payroll variance reviews, year-end validation, and preparation of payroll-related reports. Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end accounting payroll activities, including payroll journal entries, bonus accruals, payroll reconciliations, and balance sheet reconciliation related to payroll accounts. Process and review HR, payroll, and benefit-related invoices in accounting software, including invoice coding, approval follow-up, and wire/check requests. Support payroll audit requests by gathering, organizing, and validating payroll records, reports, and backup documentation. Assist with documenting payroll procedures, checklists, and process improvements to support consistent and audit-ready payroll operations. Maintain strict confidentiality of employee payroll information and sensitive records. Perform other HR and payroll-related duties as assigned. Competencies Accountability Character, Trust, Integrity Planning, Decision-Making & Initiative Development & Learning Collaboration, Communication & Teamwork Qualifications Deadline-focused, detail-oriented, organized, able to prioritize and manage concurrent demands Effective communicator (both oral and written) with ability to communicate with all staff and executive levels within the organization Team-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision Ability to establish and maintain positive working relationships with other employees Ability to effectively solve problems through the use of analytical skills Proficiency in French and advanced written and spoken English are required. English is required for this role because the incumbent will regularly support and communicate with managers, employees, payroll providers, auditors, and other third parties located outside Québec, including English-speaking Canada, the United States, Europe, and APAC. Education and/or Experience 2-3 years of payroll experience, entering payroll data and reporting Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent work experience Canadian or US Payroll Association certification preferred Experience with international payroll is a plus Functional knowledge of payroll software required, Dayforce experience preferred Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel Work Environment The position will work in a general office setting and may require travel, up to 5% annually, to remote office locations based on organizational/business needs. This position follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation to be in the office 3 days per week at the St. Petersburg, FL Corporate Office location.

The AMS Solutions Specialist plays a key role in supporting asset management sales efforts by leveraging wealth management technology and delivering high-quality advisor support. This entry-level position partners closely with Asset Management Services (AMS) consultants and internal sales teams to provide analysis, generate proposals, and assist financial advisors in utilizing the firm’s technology to enhance their investment practices.

This role combines sales support, technical proficiency, and advisor engagement. The specialist will interact directly with financial advisors via phone, Zoom, email, and occasional in-person meetings, helping them navigate portfolio construction tools, proposal generation systems, investment screeners, and tax-efficient (tax alpha) strategies. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to prioritize multiple requests in a fast-paced environment, and a passion for delivering an excellent advisor experience.

• Support asset management sales initiatives by preparing reports, analyses, and client-ready proposals

• Partner with AMS consultants and internal sales teams to fulfill inbound advisor requests and ongoing project work

• Utilize wealth management technology tools including portfolio construction, proposal generation, investment screeners, and tax alpha tools

The Premier Banker is an experienced banker, servicing as the primary contact for a complex client portfolio of mass affluent clients. The objective of the role is to grow, deepen, and retain client relationships by delivering TD’s model of convenience, sales, and advice, and differentiating with a personalized, connected experience. drawn.title: Enterprise GenAI Product Manager
drawn.body:
Location:
4910 Tiedeman Road, Brooklyn Ohio

Job Summary
The Enterprise GenAI Product Manager coordinates product strategy, discovery, requirements, product design, and roadmap planning for KeyBank’s portfolio of centrally supported Generative AI platforms, tools, and shared capabilities.
The role partners with Lines of Business, Shared Services, end users, governance partners, and technology teams to identify common needs and translate recurring demand into product concepts, user experiences, requirements, and roadmap priorities. This includes leading the product design and evolution of the AI Marketplace and related experiences that help employees discover, access, and use approved AI capabilities.
Serving as a central organizing point across existing and emerging enterprise GenAI capabilities, the Product Manager maintains an integrated view of how those capabilities work together, the needs they address, where they overlap, where gaps remain, and the support required for responsible adoption and growth. The role evaluates emerging tools and platform capabilities based on their potential value to KeyBank, intended users, access models, enterprise fit, and alignment with Key’s governance expectations and risk appetite.
The Product Manager partners with the GenAI Platform Engineering team, Microsoft and Google platform teams, Architecture, Governance, Risk, Information Security, and other stakeholders to move approved product concepts from discovery through design, build, launch, and ongoing enhancement.
Essential Functions

• Lead product discovery with Lines of Business, Shared Services, end users, capability owners, and governance and technology partners to identify recurring demand, common enterprise needs, and opportunities for centrally supported capabilities.

• Translate stakeholder needs and portfolio insights into product concepts, user journeys, business and functional requirements, experience designs, acceptance criteria, and prioritized roadmaps.

• Lead the product design and evolution of the AI Marketplace, enterprise prompt resources, capability catalogs, and other centrally supported GenAI products and experiences.

• Partner with the GenAI Platform Engineering team and other technical teams to translate approved product concepts and requirements into delivered capabilities through design, development, testing, release, and ongoing enhancement.

• Lead business exploration of emerging GenAI products and capabilities, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio LE, Agent Builder, Gemini Enterprise, Scout, evaluation platforms, and future enterprise AI offerings.

• Maintain an integrated view of the enterprise GenAI product portfolio, evaluating how platforms and capabilities interact, where they overlap, where gaps remain, and where expansion, integration, consolidation, replacement, retirement, or additional investment should be considered.

• Develop recommendations regarding product positioning, intended users, access models, priority use cases, product boundaries, rollout approaches, and readiness conditions for centrally supported GenAI tools and services.

• Evaluate proposed products and significant enhancements for employee value, enterprise fit, usability, scalability, support requirements, organizational readiness, governance and risk considerations, and compatibility with Key’s risk appetite.

• Develop business cases, product recommendations, options analyses, roadmap updates, and executive decision materials for enterprise GenAI product and capability decisions.

• Maintain current product information, including purpose, scope, target users, available capabilities, limitations, requirements, roadmap, dependencies, access and support models, ownership, and release-readiness considerations.

• Define measures of adoption, coverage, readiness, value, user experience, and capability maturity with platform, portfolio, and reporting partners. Use research, feedback, pilots, demand patterns, usage information, and platform insights to guide product enhancements.

• Coordinate product roadmaps, dependencies, handoffs, and readiness activities across Platform Engineering, Governance, Risk, Architecture, Communications & Enablement, Learning, Support, Finance, and platform-owner teams.

• Support product lifecycle decisions involving the introduction, expansion, integration, consolidation, replacement, or retirement of enterprise GenAI capabilities. Serve as a knowledgeable point of coordination for current and planned enterprise GenAI products.

• Perform other duties as assigned; duties, responsibilities, and/or activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

• Comply with all KeyBank policies and procedures, including without limitation acting professionally at all times, conducting business ethically, avoiding conflicts of interest, and acting in the best interests of Key’s clients and Key.
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, Product Design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Work Experience

• Eight or more years of experience in product management, business analysis, platform strategy, product design, technology strategy, or a related discipline.

• Experience leading product discovery and translating stakeholder needs into product requirements, user experiences, roadmaps, and solution recommendations.

• Experience designing and evolving technology products, platforms, marketplaces, catalogs, shared services, or comparable enterprise experiences.

• Experience partnering with engineering, architecture, platform, business, and control teams throughout product design, development, release, and enhancement.

• Experience evaluating emerging technologies for enterprise value, usability, readiness, scalability, and risk.

• Experience developing business cases, product recommendations, roadmap materials, and executive decision content.

• Experience with Generative AI, emerging technology, or regulated industries preferred.
Skills

• Product discovery and stakeholder engagement.

• Product strategy and roadmap planning.

• Business and functional requirements definition.

• Product design and user experience development.

• Enterprise platform and capability evaluation.

• Product portfolio positioning and lifecycle planning.

• Business case development and decision analysis.

• Analytical problem-solving and data-informed decision-making.

• Executive communication and stakeholder influence.

• Business and technical fluency.
Core Competencies

All KeyBank employees are expected to demonstrate Key’s Values and abide by Key’s Code of Conduct.

drawn.title: Internal Sales Desk Manager
drawn.body: Lazard is one of the world’s preeminent financial advisory and asset management firms. Our people and culture make the difference . While global in presence and reach, ours is a close, collaborative community of just over 3,000 professionals. Lazard is a place of continuous knowledge sharing, skill development and relationship building, where professionals grow and succeed together. Our entrepreneurial culture, flat structure and embrace of individual differences, allow creative ideas, original concepts, and unique perspectives to drive our business forward — and for careers to take flight. We are looking for an Internal Sales Desk Manager to lead our Field Sales internal wholesaler desk based in New York. You will coach and develop a team of early-career sales professionals from Internal to Hybrid and, ultimately, External Wholesaler roles. We are looking for an organized, respected leader and coach who can assess capability quickly, give actionable real-time feedback, and translate sales strategy into disciplined daily execution on the desk. We’ll trust you to: Lead and coach the internal desk: Manage the daily operations, activity standards, and performance culture of the internal sales team to drive asset growth and qualified appointment setting for external partners. Assess and develop desk talent: Rapidly evaluate each individual’s sales capability, product knowledge, and commercial judgment; build targeted development plans with measurable expectations; accelerate high potentials and address performance gaps promptly and directly. Own onboarding for the desk: Deliver structured onboarding for new internal sales hires covering the firm, our products, systems, sales process, and client segments, so new joiners reach productivity quickly. Build desk-level skills: Run focused skill-building on the capabilities the desk needs day to day — product mastery, consultative selling, discovery, prospecting and cold calling, objection handling, and partnership with the external wholesaler. Coach in real time: Listen in on live calls and pipeline work and give immediate, practical feedback on client conversations, product positioning, and follow-up discipline. Manage career progression: Execute a structured framework with clear, communicated advancement criteria that prepares internal wholesalers for Hybrid roles (combining virtual and targeted physical coverage) and eventual External territory ownership. Oversee licensing and technical competency: Manage the desk’s licensing path (SIE, Series 7, 63/65) and ongoing product training for new and tenured team members. Partner on distribution strategy: Work with Sales Leadership to implement business priorities, identify territory coverage gaps, and leverage CRM data to prioritize market opportunities based on revenue potential. Run a disciplined operating rhythm: Lead team meetings, pipeline reviews, and one-on-ones, and use CRM, sales analytics, and AI-enabled tools to track desk KPIs, surface coaching needs, and measure individual progress. Uphold firm standards: Ensure sales activity and client interactions are documented appropriately and conducted in line with firm policies, compliance requirements, and approved messaging. You’ll need to have: Industry experience: Minimum of 10 years in asset management retail distribution, including ownership of an external territory (ideally across channels and geographies). Leadership track record: Minimum of 5 years leading and developing field sales talent, specifically internals and hybrids, with a record of progressing junior sales professionals into senior production roles within a structured retail sales environment. Talent development: Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and develop early-career sales talent, and to deliver timely, direct, and constructive feedback that changes behavior. Channel expertise: Deep technical knowledge of the Wirehouse, IBD, and RIA landscapes, including platform dynamics and advisor workflows. Advanced sales skills: Mastery of consultative selling, discovery-based prospecting, and high-impact cold calling, with the ability to translate these into practical coaching and training for internal sales professionals. Analytical proficiency: Experience using CRM (Salesforce) and sales analytics to drive territory planning, measure desk KPIs, and manage team and individual performance through a metricized, accountable approach; familiarity with AI-enabled workflow or coaching tools. Collaboration and judgment: Ability to work effectively with senior leaders, external wholesalers, Product, Marketing, National Accounts, and Compliance, with professional integrity and an authentic, respectful leadership style. Required licensing: Active Series 7 and 63/65 (or 66); Series 24 (Principal) preferred, or must be obtained within a specified timeframe. Education and product background: Bachelor’s degree preferred; experience with investment management, retirement, insurance, or other financial services products is a plus. What we offer We strive to enhance the total health and well-being of our employees through comprehensive, competitive benefits. Our goal is to offer a highly individualized employee experience that enables you to balance your commitments to career, family, and community. When you work for Lazard, you are working for an organization that cares about your unique talents and passions, and will continue to invest in the development of your career. We expect the base salary range for this role to be approximately $180,000-$200,000 USD. Various factors contribute to determining the actual base compensation offered, including but not limited to the applicant’s years of relevant experience, career tenure, qualifications, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, relevant skills for the role. Base salary is one component of Lazard Asset Management’s compensation package, which also includes comprehensive benefits and may include incentive compensation. Representation at Lazard Lazard is an intellectual capital business committed to delivering the best advice and solutions to clients. To achieve these objectives, we focus on attracting, developing and retaining the best talent. We believe that a workforce comprised of people who represent a wide array of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives creates a rich variety of thought that empowers us to challenge conventional wisdom, solve problems creatively and make better decisions. Lazard was built on the premise that a multicultural firm can best serve a global clientele. As a global firm that has grown organically from local roots in different countries, we have a deep tradition of respecting and appreciating individual differences. Doing so has been core to our success for over 175 years. We are committed to sustaining an environment where every colleague is supported in their professional pursuits, can maximize their individual potential and contribute to our collective success. #LI-CN1 We are looking for an Internal Sales Desk Manager to lead our Field Sales internal wholesaler desk based in New York.

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Line of Business:
Personal & Commercial Banking Job Description:
The Premier Banker is an experienced banker, servicing as the primary contact for a complex client portfolio of mass affluent clients. Through proactive outreach, this role manages mass affluent clients' complete banking relationship and connects clients to specialists to ensure all financial needs are met. The objective of the role is to grow, deepen, and retain client relationships by delivering TD’s model of convenience, sales, and advice, and differentiating with a personalized, connected experience. Premier Bankers play a critical role in delivering TD's mass affluent premier value, building lasting relationships and providing legendary service to a valued set of clients.

Depth & Scope:

• Works in a bank location and will be accountable to grow, deepen, and retain strong relationships with a mass affluent book of business by proactively managing and addressing their banking needs with an advice-based approach
• Demonstrates proficiency and in-depth knowledge in banking and credit products, offerings, and processes to fluently explain banking solutions to a client and to act as an experienced liaison with internal partners in small business, wealth, commercial and lending
• Acquires, retains and deepens relationships with new mass affluent clients by converting referrals, leads, and outbound prospecting
• Proactively engages in client outreach (via phone, email, appointments, and other means) and regularly meets with clients to conduct needs-based conversations, review and analyze financial information, suggest appropriate solutions and/or service options, and coordinate introductions/interactions with appropriate partners
• Delivers excellent client service, reviews moderately complex clients concerns, and escalates banking related issues/risks when appropriate
• Adheres to all relevant Retail/Wealth policies, procedures, FINRA and regulatory banking requirements
• Engages in conversations with clients about loan products; facilitates the application intake. Must maintain an active registration status with NMLS (Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry)
• Establishes and maintains strong working relationships with partners via ongoing meetings and collaboration to identify areas for relationship deepening in Wealth, Commercial, Small Business, Lending, etc.
• Partners regularly with the Wealth Financial Advisor including warm referrals and joint pipeline and joint pipeline review meetings to prepare for future client interactions.
• Provides ongoing coaching and ongoing feedback to bank staff on effective methods to articulate the program's value and make Premier referrals for mass affluent clients
• Responsible for understanding and adhering to regulations, TD Bank & TD Wealth Policies and Procedures
• Responsible for implementing TD’s client Identification Program (CIP) by collecting and verifying required customer identification information and performing other client Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence Requirements as outlined in the Business Unit AML procedures

Education & Experience:

• HS Diploma or GED (required)
• Bachelor's / University degree or equivalent experience preferred
• 2+ years financial / banking experience
• Successful completion of the Securities Industry Essentials Exam (SIE) strongly preferred
• Life & Health license preferred
• Understanding and experience with retail and small business banking; experience interacting with Mass Affluent and high net worth clients
• Must maintain an active registration status with NMLS (Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry) upon hire
• Consultative sales experience required

Customer Accountabilities:

• Delivers the TD Premier program to eligible Clients
• Knowledgeable in products and services to be able act as an educator and advisor to clients
• Requires established client service skills to perform a broad range of both routine and multi-step Customer transactions
• Establishes and nurtures client relationships through proactive outreach, ongoing engagement, consistent display of product knowledge, actively listening to client needs and offering advice based solutions or partner referrals.
• Utilizes client relationship tools to engage in needs-based conversations to identify solutions and provide proactive advice
• Understands client's banking preferences with banking and educates clients & non- clients on current promotions and campaigns as well as tools and resources to make banking easier for the client
• Understands and supports the Bank's Customer Service Strategy
• Delivers client end-to-end advice they expect: (1) building trust with educational content & tools, (2) providing consultative support, and (3) advocating for them with proactive insights & recommendations
• Considers the impact of decisions on the well-being of TD, its clients, and stakeholders
• Provides the highest level of client service when dealing with internal partners or vendors
• Works as a single point of contact to clients by exploring various products or services and connecting the client with partners as needed

Shareholder Accountabilities:

• Contributes to business objectives for Operational Excellence by championing and reviewing team against compliance with regulations; fully understanding accountability in driving an operationally sound location
• Ensures documentation that is prepared / completed is accurate and properly reflects client/ business intentions and is consistent with relevant rules / regulations
• Applies Compliance policies and regulations to all transactions to ensure integrity of proper compliance with all documentation that operational requirements are followed and that the appropriate documentation is recorded
• Engages in conversations with clients regarding loan applications, prepares documents, and conducts loan closings
• Meets individual / Store performance metrics

Employee/Team Accountabilities:

• Contributes to a positive work environment by aligning to TD Model, Brand, and Culture by participating fully as a member of the team
• Is an active participant in personal performance and development activities
• Acts as a brand champion both internally and externally
• Collaborates with team members in contributing to the success of the team and organization
• Partners as a team player
• Strong relationship building and selling skills
• Detail oriented, well organized, self-starter with high energy level
• Actively seeks opportunities to improve delivery of work with high attention to quality standards
• Actively takes ownership of own career and aspirations; seeks out diverse feedback to continuously develop and enhance skills
• Positively embraces change
• Adheres and participates in TD's Shared Commitments
• Models quality service at every client interaction
• Is engaged in advancing and sustaining a unique, inclusive culture that reflects TD's diversity agenda, and creates an extraordinary employee experience
• May train and act as a mentor to newer colleagues
• Leverages the expertise and capabilities of other businesses / partners to better achieve mutual goals in collaboration
• The role is expected to lead continuous coaching in assigned bank locations on all topics supporting the growth of the Mass Affluent segment portfolio / book of business

Who We Are:
TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

Accommodation

drawn.title: GSOC Manager
drawn.body:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you’ve been searching for!

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently looking to hire a GSOC Manager to join our team embedded with our client in Detroit, MI! This position requires working on-site at our client's headquarters located in Detroit, MI.

This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are generally Monday through Friday, though hours are based upon position needs. Evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The GSOC Manager is responsible for leading and managing the day-to-day operations of a 24/7 Global Security Operations Center that serves as the operational intake, triage, escalation, and coordination hub for Global Security. The GSOC Manager ensures the team delivers timely, accurate security monitoring, incident response, intelligence support, escalation management, and operational coordination. This individual will use intelligence sources, internal and external assets, and open-source media to identify threats and provide timely and accurate information to company leadership.

This is a people-leadership role: the GSOC Manager maintains a high-performing, resilient embedded team environment and works closely with Concentric and client leadership to support GSOC objectives and address emerging risks. The role oversees the GSOC's emergency response procedures for critical incidents, including political instability, violence, travel alerts, health concerns, man-made or natural disasters, internal threats, or technical failures. Working within established procedures and escalation protocols, the GSOC Manager coordinates the response, validates information, maintains situational awareness, communicates with and escalates to leadership, and supports the responsible business and functional teams through resolution. The GSOC Manager carries direct supervisory responsibility for a shift-based team of GSOC Operators and Analysts, to include hiring, coaching, performance management, and scheduling to ensure 24/7 coverage.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate with internal teams and tasking groups (intelligence, investigations, operations) to ensure successful, quality-controlled completion of GSOC assignments, fostering collaborative team dynamics.
  • Manage the GSOC as the central intake, triage, escalation, and coordination point for security-related incidents, requests, alerts, and operational information, ensuring matters are appropriately categorized, prioritized, assigned, escalated, and tracked through closure.
  • Ensure GSOC personnel consistently follow established procedures, protocols, and operational standards, and monitor the quality, timeliness, and accuracy of security monitoring, reporting, intelligence, and incident response activities.
  • When clear guidance is not available, determine the appropriate course of action within established GSOC procedures and escalation protocols, provide instruction to the team, escalate to Global Security leadership as appropriate, and provide clear and informed briefings to leadership.
  • Evaluate and recommend process-improvement strategies to strengthen GSOC operations and performance.
  • Serve as the day-to-day operational point of coordination with the client's Global Security leadership and key internal stakeholders, ensuring professional communication and prompt resolution of operational concerns.
  • Conduct regular risk assessments and post-incident After-Action Reviews (AARs) to identify operational gaps, refine response procedures, and brief leadership on findings.
  • Draft emergency mass notifications and crisis communications and disseminate them when authorized under established protocols, and prepare concise status and incident reports for multiple stakeholders.
  • Support the evaluation, implementation, adoption, and effective operational use of technology, automation, analytics, and other capabilities that improve intelligence gathering, situational awareness, communication, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide direct leadership and performance management to GSOC personnel, establishing clear expectations, priorities and accountability in coordination with Concentric leadership.
  • Lead full-cycle people management- interviewing, onboarding, training, coaching, performance reviews and measurable development plans.
  • Ensure the team maintains a high level of professionalism, situational awareness, and operational discipline.
  • Oversee quality control of GSOC products, liaise on a regular basis with partner teams to review and update processes and protocols. Identify gaps in processes and resources, develop solutions to address these gaps as part of the larger Concentric strategy. Coordinate a monthly meeting with all tasking teams to go over upcoming projects and foster continuous feedback.
  • Monitor and report GSOC operational performance through established KPIs and service levels, including response and escalation timeliness, reporting quality, staffing and coverage, incident handling, and other agreed performance measures.
  • Facilitate GSOC shifts and ensure the shift schedule provides 24/7 coverage, ensuring thorough shift handoffs to main continuity of ongoing incidents.
  • Maintain GSOC operational continuity and resilience, including staffing contingencies, technology disruptions, alternate procedures, and continuity of critical monitoring and communications capabilities.
  • Ensure the team documents incidents and escalations per GSOC reporting standards (shift logs, SITREPs, after-action reports), maintains SOPs, and appropriately escalates incidents, threats, and critical events to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the team monitors CCTV, access control, and alarm systems, and effectively uses travel risk management platforms to track and issue timely emergency alerts.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in corporate security, intelligence, law enforcement, military, or security operations, with at least 2 years managing or supervising a 24/7 GSOC or comparable operations center.
  • Demonstrated experience with staffing, scheduling, and performance management, including coaching and corrective action.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound decision-making under pressure, and the ability to engage senior leadership and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficient with Security Operational software (mass notification, incident management, or travel risk platforms.
  • Excellent English-language proficiency, both written and verbal.
  • Practical understanding of risk-based security management and physical security principles.
  • Hands-on experience with physical security systems, including CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, and visitor management.
  • Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, international security, political science, or a related field.
  • Military service or prior experience in a GSOC or similar operations center may substitute for educational requirements.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience managing a GSOC team within an embedded corporate environment.
  • Thorough understanding of OSINT research, investigation, and information assessments to review and/or disseminate team products.
  • Foreign language proficiency, given global monitoring capabilities.
  • Experience developing staffing models, shift schedules, KPI/SLA reporting frameworks, and career-development pathways.
  • Active professional security certifications or memberships.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • The HSA medical plan covers 100% of the premium for employee-only coverage. The PPO medical plan requires an employee contribution for employee-only coverage. For both plans, Concentric covers a substantial portion of the premium for dependents.
  • Concentric also offers an HSA employer contribution
  • Medical FSA
  • Employer-paid insurance: life, STD, LTD, and AD&D
  • 401 (k) including employer match
  • 11 paid holidays
  • Paid leave (vacation, sick, parental)
  • Annual Health & Wellness Benefit
  • Pet Insurance
  • National discount employee program
  • Employee Assistance Program for personal needs
  • Credentity Protection - Eclipse Digital Protection by Concentric
  • Free access to our Risk Intelligence Dashboard and GEAR App. Providing 24/7 access to trusted risk intelligence and remote support, helping you stay informed, prepared, and protected wherever you operate.
  • Dedicated Security and Intelligence Training Programs for Professional Development
  • Coaching and Mentoring Opportunities
Detroit Pay Range
$125,000—$125,000 USD

Concentric and SPS Global acknowledge the systemic barriers in the security industry and recognize that removing those barriers will require a collaborative and conscious effort. Concentric and SPS Global are committed to programs and initiatives that promote diversity, equity, and inclusion, enhancing our organization and the broader community. We are creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Work Location:

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Line of Business:
Personal & Commercial Banking Job Description:
The Premier Banker is an experienced banker, servicing as the primary contact for a complex client portfolio of mass affluent clients. Through proactive outreach, this role manages mass affluent clients' complete banking relationship and connects clients to specialists to ensure all financial needs are met. The objective of the role is to grow, deepen, and retain client relationships by delivering TD’s model of convenience, sales, and advice, and differentiating with a personalized, connected experience. Premier Bankers play a critical role in delivering TD's mass affluent premier value, building lasting relationships and providing legendary service to a valued set of clients.

Depth & Scope:

• Works in a bank location and will be accountable to grow, deepen, and retain strong relationships with a mass affluent book of business by proactively managing and addressing their banking needs with an advice-based approach
• Demonstrates proficiency and in-depth knowledge in banking and credit products, offerings, and processes to fluently explain banking solutions to a client and to act as an experienced liaison with internal partners in small business, wealth, commercial and lending
• Acquires, retains and deepens relationships with new mass affluent clients by converting referrals, leads, and outbound prospecting
• Proactively engages in client outreach (via phone, email, appointments, and other means) and regularly meets with clients to conduct needs-based conversations, review and analyze financial information, suggest appropriate solutions and/or service options, and coordinate introductions/interactions with appropriate partners
• Delivers excellent client service, reviews moderately complex clients concerns, and escalates banking related issues/risks when appropriate
• Adheres to all relevant Retail/Wealth policies, procedures, FINRA and regulatory banking requirements
• Engages in conversations with clients about loan products; facilitates the application intake. Must maintain an active registration status with NMLS (Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry)
• Establishes and maintains strong working relationships with partners via ongoing meetings and collaboration to identify areas for relationship deepening in Wealth, Commercial, Small Business, Lending, etc.
• Partners regularly with the Wealth Financial Advisor including warm referrals and joint pipeline and joint pipeline review meetings to prepare for future client interactions.
• Provides ongoing coaching and ongoing feedback to bank staff on effective methods to articulate the program's value and make Premier referrals for mass affluent clients
• Responsible for understanding and adhering to regulations, TD Bank & TD Wealth Policies and Procedures
• Responsible for implementing TD’s client Identification Program (CIP) by collecting and verifying required customer identification information and performing other client Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence Requirements as outlined in the Business Unit AML procedures

Education & Experience:

• HS Diploma or GED (required)
• Bachelor's / University degree or equivalent experience preferred
• 2+ years financial / banking experience
• Successful completion of the Securities Industry Essentials Exam (SIE) strongly preferred
• Life & Health license preferred
• Understanding and experience with retail and small business banking; experience interacting with Mass Affluent and high net worth clients
• Must maintain an active registration status with NMLS (Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry) upon hire
• Consultative sales experience required

Customer Accountabilities:

• Delivers the TD Premier program to eligible Clients
• Knowledgeable in products and services to be able act as an educator and advisor to clients
• Requires established client service skills to perform a broad range of both routine and multi-step Customer transactions
• Establishes and nurtures client relationships through proactive outreach, ongoing engagement, consistent display of product knowledge, actively listening to client needs and offering advice based solutions or partner referrals.
• Utilizes client relationship tools to engage in needs-based conversations to identify solutions and provide proactive advice
• Understands client's banking preferences with banking and educates clients & non- clients on current promotions and campaigns as well as tools and resources to make banking easier for the client
• Understands and supports the Bank's Customer Service Strategy
• Delivers client end-to-end advice they expect: (1) building trust with educational content & tools, (2) providing consultative support, and (3) advocating for them with proactive insights & recommendations
• Considers the impact of decisions on the well-being of TD, its clients, and stakeholders
• Provides the highest level of client service when dealing with internal partners or vendors
• Works as a single point of contact to clients by exploring various products or services and connecting the client with partners as needed

Shareholder Accountabilities:

• Contributes to business objectives for Operational Excellence by championing and reviewing team against compliance with regulations; fully understanding accountability in driving an operationally sound location
• Ensures documentation that is prepared / completed is accurate and properly reflects client/ business intentions and is consistent with relevant rules / regulations
• Applies Compliance policies and regulations to all transactions to ensure integrity of proper compliance with all documentation that operational requirements are followed and that the appropriate documentation is recorded
• Engages in conversations with clients regarding loan applications, prepares documents, and conducts loan closings
• Meets individual / Store performance metrics

Employee/Team Accountabilities:

• Contributes to a positive work environment by aligning to TD Model, Brand, and Culture by participating fully as a member of the team
• Is an active participant in personal performance and development activities
• Acts as a brand champion both internally and externally
• Collaborates with team members in contributing to the success of the team and organization
• Partners as a team player
• Strong relationship building and selling skills
• Detail oriented, well organized, self-starter with high energy level
• Actively seeks opportunities to improve delivery of work with high attention to quality standards
• Actively takes ownership of own career and aspirations; seeks out diverse feedback to continuously develop and enhance skills
• Positively embraces change
• Adheres and participates in TD's Shared Commitments
• Models quality service at every client interaction
• Is engaged in advancing and sustaining a unique, inclusive culture that reflects TD's diversity agenda, and creates an extraordinary employee experience
• May train and act as a mentor to newer colleagues
• Leverages the expertise and capabilities of other businesses / partners to better achieve mutual goals in collaboration
• The role is expected to lead continuous coaching in assigned bank locations on all topics supporting the growth of the Mass Affluent segment portfolio / book of business

OCC:

• This position falls within the definition of Loan Originator as defined under Regulation Z of the Truth in Lending Act, 12 CFR Part 1026.36, and the definition of Mortgage Loan Originator as defined under the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage
• Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act), 12 U.S.C. §§ 5102 et seq., and its implementing regulations, 12 CFR Part 1007
• Must be eligible for employment with a covered financial institution under the standards established by Regulation Z of the Truth in Lending Act, 12 CFR Part 1026.36
• Must be eligible for registration as a registered mortgage loan originator with the NMLS (Nationwide Mortgage Licensing
• System and Registry) in accordance with the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act), 12 U.S.C. §§ 5102 et seq., and its implementing regulations, 12 CFR Part 1007
• Satisfactory results on a criminal background check and a credit report check, and statements/certification from job applicant regarding administrative, civil, and/or criminal findings by any government agency/authority, are required by federal law for this position

Who We Are:
TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Colleague Development
If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation
TD Bank is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you are an applicant with a disability and need accommodations to complete the application process, please email TD Bank US Workplace Accommodations Program at USWAPTDO@td.com . Include your full name, best way to reach you and the accommodation needed to assist you with the applicant process.

drawn.title: Producing Financial Planner
drawn.body: RiversEdge Advisors is a financial planning firm in Wilmington, DE and we are seeking a Producing Financial Planner to join our team. We are a fee-based firm located right on the Christina River. The Producing Financial Planner will support our continued growth and to help manage existing client relationships. Find out more about us at our website: riversedgeadvisors.com Responsibilities include: Serves as an advisor to provide an advice-based approach to financial solutions for an assigned book of business. Actively solicits new and existing financial planning and investments solutions from business owner, retiree, executive and young professional client segment Based on individualized needs analysis, collaborates with Financial Advisory team to create recommendations for customized financial solutions to current and potential customers. Profiles clients and deliver recommendations to ensure these needs are met. Uses sales tools and modules to conduct the analysis and offer the best advice and products and customer understanding of solutions. Delivers a diversified set of investment and advice-based solutions with a financial planning mindset to meet the individualized investment needs of current and potential clients. Increases assets under management by offering planning and investment solutions to clients and leveraging partnerships with centers of influence and current clients. Provides financial planning services by advising the customer on the advantages and disadvantages of different product decisions in alignment with their individual needs. Follows firm process of regularly meeting with clients to make adjustments to strategies based on their current situation and goals. Meets or exceeds established sales goals for assigned market, while meeting individual client needs and complying with pertinent policies and regulations. Maintains and builds referral channel and develop strong partnerships to ensure investment needs of current and potential customers in assigned Market and/or branches are met or exceeded. Understands and adheres to the company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls. Maintains internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable. Completes other related duties as assigned. Position Requirements: Bachelor’s degree; preferably in business Prior business development experience necessary (5+ years) Must have or obtain appropriate investment licenses (within 90 days of hire) Vast networking skills Good written and verbal communication skills Team player, collaborative, able to work with and through others Desire/ability to work successfully in a small company environment Familiarity with our current systems is a plus, but not required: RedTail, eMoney, Riskalyze, Schwab, Orion Benefits: The salary range for this position will be competitive with the market depending on experience and credentials Competitive healthcare with company match to HSA Ability to work remotely on an as-needed basis with manager approval 401(k) after 6 months of employment Personal and bereavement leave Upbeat and lively working environment A background and credit check will be required. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

drawn.title: Salesforce Development Engineer & Systems Engineer
drawn.body:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

Position: Salesforce Development Engineer & Systems Engineer

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and support scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with business, security, integration, and operational requirements.
• Lead development efforts across Salesforce platforms, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Experience Cloud, Agentforce, and DealCloud.
• Develop Proof of Concepts (POCs) and technical prototypes to evaluate new Salesforce capabilities, Agentforce use cases, AI-driven solutions, and integration patterns.
• Provide technical leadership, perform code reviews, and mentor junior developers.
• Drive solution architecture, system integrations, data modeling, and application performance optimization.
• Promote Salesforce best practices, leveraging declarative capabilities before custom development where appropriate.
• Support Agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment automation.
• Collaborate with business and technology teams to deliver high-quality, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
• Support onboarding and ongoing oversight of vendor-provided applications, helping ensure alignment with onboarding, security, and operational requirements and coordinating required evidence or artifacts.
• Own day-to-day coordination for a defined portfolio of applications, serving as the primary point of contact for business, technology, and vendor stakeholders.
• Coordinate operational workflows, including incident triage, routine maintenance, releases, and enhancement intake, track risks, dependencies, and remediation through closure.
• Communicate status, impact, and next steps to stakeholders in a clear, timely manner, adapting technical details to the audience

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience, with 5-7 years of Salesforce development experience with strong expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Triggers, APIs, and Salesforce security architecture.
• Experience with implementing Agentforce , Financial Services Cloud (FSC) , and DealCloud implementations or integrations.
• Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and enterprise integration patterns.
• Proven ability to lead development teams and deliver complex enterprise Salesforce solutions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
• Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer, Application Architect, System Architect, FSC, or AI/Agentforce certifications
• Experience developing POCs, evaluating emerging Salesforce features, and providing architecture recommendations based on business and technical feasibility.
• Working knowledge of core technology concepts, including application behavior across environments, servers and processes, system logs, and system integrations
• Strong organizational and prioritization skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non technical audiences

Preferred Experience

• Financial Services, Banking, Capital Markets industry experience.
• Experience with enterprise integration platforms such as Informatica, or similar middleware solutions.
• Knowledge of AI-driven Salesforce solutions, conversational agents, and intelligent automation.

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely-related discipline, or an equivalent combination of formal education and experience

drawn.title: Junior Operations Manager
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Support the day-to-day operations of a direct-to-consumer consumer health business, coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, technology partners, and internal teams. You will help improve supply chain and fulfillment processes so customers receive orders efficiently.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Coordinate with producers, warehouses, and software providers to support order fulfillment and inventory management.

- Review operational workflows and identify opportunities to improve processes and manage costs.

- Support supply chain planning and logistics execution to meet customer delivery commitments.

- Use ERP and logistics tools to track shipments, inventory, and operational metrics.

- Work with internal teams and external partners to resolve operational bottlenecks.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Up to two years of full-time professional experience, including experience in consulting, strategy, operations, or internships with practical operational exposure.

- Hands-on exposure to operations, supply chain, or logistics, with experience in a direct-to-consumer or e-commerce environment.

- Familiarity with ERP systems or logistics software; exposure to warehouse management systems is helpful.

- Fluency in German and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong analytical problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders.

- Experience with supply chain optimization, process improvement, customer support, or customer experience operations is useful.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary range: €40,000 to €60,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

LOCATION

On-site in Berlin, Germany.

drawn.title: Early-Career Account Executive
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI-driven HR technology company as its first Account Executive. You will own the sales cycle from prospecting through close and work closely with the founders to shape the go-to-market approach. Your work will help establish the sales playbook and inform product improvements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, discovery, product demos, negotiation, and closing.

- Research target accounts, run outbound campaigns, and build pipeline from scratch.

- Navigate sales cycles with HR leaders, finance executives, and IT procurement teams.

- Partner with the founders to refine the ideal customer profile, test messaging, and develop the sales playbook.

- Share customer pain points and product feedback with Product and Engineering.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Recent graduate or early-career professional with 0 to 2 years of experience and a demonstrated commitment to a sales career.

- Experience closing enterprise deals and selling in HR technology.

- Outbound prospecting experience, with evidence of building pipeline and a hunter mindset through work, internships, campus sales, SDR experience, or self-directed outreach.

- Experience at a startup or small business, or the ability to operate with limited infrastructure and ambiguity.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills; interest in HR, finance, or AI is valuable.

- Authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation includes a base salary of $65,000 to $75,000 and on-target earnings of $140,000, with a 50/50 base and commission split. Visa sponsorship is not available.

LOCATION

Remote within the United States.

drawn.title: Junior to Mid-Level GTM Engineer
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a team of GTM Engineers building AI-powered outbound systems for a B2B growth and lead generation agency and its clients. You will help create end-to-end workflows that turn market signals into qualified sales conversations, using a low-code approach that does not require software development.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build outbound systems from lead sourcing and data enrichment through personalized messaging and campaign execution.

- Use intent, job changes, funding, and other signals to develop targeted prospecting sequences.

- Design Clay tables with enrichment workflows, waterfalls, and AI columns.

- Automate GTM workflows with tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.

- Run and evaluate outbound campaigns, tracking metrics such as reply rates, meetings booked, and pipeline generated.

- Use campaign results and analytical judgment to improve targeting, qualification, and messaging.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Junior to mid-level experience, with first professional experience in outbound, lead generation, RevOps, or growth.

- Hands-on experience building in Clay, including enrichment, waterfalls, and AI columns.

- A track record of running outbound campaigns and measuring results, including through work, internships, or personal projects.

- Experience automating workflows with n8n, Make, or Zapier, and using AI tools or LLMs for GTM work, such as prompting or Claygent.

- Strong business and analytical thinking, ownership, and the ability to build systems end to end.

- Native-level German and willingness to work from the Berlin office three days per week. The first month is fully on-site.

- Familiarity with tools such as Claude Code, HeyReach, Zapmail, and Pipedrive is useful. Coding is not required.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Fixed salary of €55,000 to €70,000 annually, plus €5,000 variable compensation. Visa sponsorship is not available.

LOCATION

Hybrid in Berlin, Germany, with three days per week in the office.

drawn.title: Account Coordinator, Strategic Communications and Public Affairs
drawn.body:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

Red Flag USA , part of the Ankura Consulting Group, is a multi-award-winning strategic communications and public affairs agency that delivers tailored analysis, trusted counsel, and winning strategies to help clients navigate their most critical challenges in the Americas and around the world.

The role of Account Coordinator (Strategic Communications and Public Affairs) will support client service across our growing U.S. and international client base. At Red Flag, Account Coordinators are responsible for supporting communications plans, monitoring news and policy developments, analyzing and researching client issues, and supporting account servicing teams in other ways, as assigned.

This is a full-time position based in our office in Washington, DC, with arrangements for hybrid working.

Responsibilities
● Support development and implementation of communications and public affairs strategies on behalf of major clients in a range of sectors.
● Monitor and analyze media, social media, and policy developments, as assigned, and draft timely reports for clients.
● Draft and deliver high-quality written products for internal and external purposes, including briefing papers, talking points, press releases, social media content, and presentations.
● Support business development, including through supporting development of proposal materials.

Required Skills and Experience
Candidates must be highly-motivated, proactive, eager to learn, and open to working in a fast-paced environment on a wide range of issues.

The ideal candidate will have:
● Prior work or internship experience in public relations and/or public affairs
● Strong written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated ability to create error-free materials such as press releases, briefing memos, talking points, social media content, etc.
● Excellent interpersonal skills and proven ability to make positive contributions to successful teams
● Proven ability to deliver in detailed and time-sensitive projects

drawn.title: Technical Operations Lead
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As Technical Operations Lead at an AI/ML company, you will work closely with the founders to turn strategic priorities into effective operational systems. You will improve workflows, build internal tools, and help teams coordinate as the organization grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Partner with founders on high-priority initiatives such as hiring, communications, and internal planning.

- Build and maintain internal tools to track key metrics and improve operational visibility.

- Coordinate across teams to identify and reduce project and workflow bottlenecks.

- Review existing processes and implement practical improvements using technical and analytical approaches.

- Experiment with AI tools to improve team productivity and effectiveness.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience working on high-priority operational tasks, such as hiring, communications, or internal planning.

- A track record of coordinating across teams and projects to identify and address bottlenecks.

- Experience improving internal processes and defining or monitoring key metrics with custom-built tools.

- Comfort working in a high-growth startup environment, taking ownership, and constructively challenging existing approaches.

- Proficiency with AI tools and interest in experimenting with new technologies.

- Knowledge of Swiss legal frameworks or experience in recruiting, communications, or related operations is a plus.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Competitive compensation plus equity. Visa sponsorship is available.
