drawn.body:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

Permanent, full-time | Based in Washington, DC | Competitive salary

Red Flag is looking for a driven, detail-oriented Account Executive to join our growing Washington, DC team. We want someone who takes initiative, supports senior colleagues in servicing major clients, helps drive day-to-day account delivery, and contributes to high-impact campaigns for clients across the US and internationally.

This is a key hire for Red Flag, the multi-award-winning strategic communications and campaigns consultancy. Our clients trust our global team of strategists and campaigners, drawn from the worlds of media, politics, business and diplomacy, to cut through the noise on their toughest regulatory, reputational and communications challenges. We specialize in integrated advocacy campaigns on sensitive, complex and business-critical issues, combining public affairs, media relations, digital mobilization, coalition building and grassroots activation to deliver for our clients.

From our offices in Washington DC, Brussels, London, Dublin and Cape Town, we have delivered for clients in more than 52 countries across five continents, advising some of the world’s most recognized companies, coalitions and industry associations.

Now part of Ankura, the world-leading expert services and advisory firm, we can put a global bench of subject-matter experts behind every campaign we run. Ankura hires people to think big and make things happen. On that strength, we are scaling our US operations and expanding our international client portfolio.

About the role

Following a series of major new client wins, Red Flag is recruiting an Account Executive (Public Affairs) to support engagement across our growing US and international client base. This is a role for someone who wants to learn quickly, take on responsibility early, and build a strong foundation in public affairs and strategic communications.

At Red Flag, Account Executives play a key part in the accounts they work on. You will support the day-to-day delivery of communications and public affairs programs, help task and support Account Coordinators, and serve as a reliable point of contact for clients on routine matters. We give people real responsibility early, backed by senior support to help them grow quickly.

This position is scoped to be based in our Washington, DC office, with arrangements for hybrid working. Some domestic and international travel may be required.

Responsibilities
● Supports the Account Manager in the day-to-day running of client accounts, acting as a reliable point of contact on routine matters.

● Assists with the development and execution of communications and public affairs strategies for clients across a range of sectors.
● Monitors and analyzes media, social media and policy developments, and drafts clear, accurate reporting for clients.
● Drafts and edits written products for internal and external purposes, including briefing memos, talking points, social media content, op-eds and presentations.
● Helps plan and run client activity such as fly-ins, media events, briefings, roundtables and coalition meetings, including logistics, materials and on-site support.
● Supports new business development, including research, pitch materials and identifying new opportunities.
● Works closely with colleagues across our five offices on a wide range of client issues.

Required Skills and Experience

We are looking for an organized self-starter with:
● 1-3 years of experience in a professional environment; internships or experience in public affairs, on Capitol Hill, in a federal agency, on a campaign or in the media are a plus.
● A developing understanding of the US political and regulatory process, with an interest in Defense, Energy, or Healthcare policy.
● Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, accurate materials such as press releases, briefing memos and talking points.
● Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple, time-sensitive projects at once.
● Good judgment and the confidence to task and support junior colleagues.
● Excellent interpersonal skills and a proven ability to contribute positively to a team.
● A genuine interest in learning quickly and taking on a wide range of issues.

What we offer

At Red Flag, you will join a growing agency that invests in talent and rewards performance, backed by the reach of Ankura. We are proud to offer:
● Competitive salary and benefits, tailored to experience
● Annual bonus scheme
● Clear pathways to promotion and internal advancement
● Structured mentorship and in-house training
● Professional development support
● Hybrid working options

drawn.title: Associate — Forensic Investigations
drawn.body:
We Do Consulting Differently

We are establishing BRG's Forensic Investigations practice in Germany. This is a genuine build — a new team, in a new market, with the methodology, credentials and global network of an established international firm behind it, and without the constraints of a legacy structure.

The practice focuses on two connected disciplines: forensic accounting and fraud investigations, and forensic technology and eDiscovery. Our work typically arises where the facts are contested and the stakes are high — special investigations for supervisory boards and audit committees, allegations of financial misstatement, corruption and misappropriation, regulatory and criminal proceedings, and post-transaction disputes.

Our entry-level role for graduates and career starters. No prior forensic experience is required — curiosity, precision and a head for data are what matter.

Your Responsibilities

• Support forensic analyses: preparing, cleansing and reconciling data from accounting and ERP systems.
• Review documents in eDiscovery platforms and apply the review protocol consistently.
• Research corporate registries, public filings and open sources, and summarise findings clearly.
• Prepare and maintain working papers, indices and evidence logs.
• Build exhibits, tables and charts for investigation reports.
• Assist with the logistical and organisational side of investigations — which, on a live matter, is a substantial contribution in its own right.

Your Profile

• A completed or nearly completed degree in business administration, accounting, economics, finance, law, information systems, data science or a comparable subject.
• Internships or working student roles in audit, forensics, compliance, law or data analytics are welcome but not a prerequisite.
• An Interest in any of the following: Forensic Accounting, Digital Forensics, Artificial Intelligence or Forensic Data Review.
• Confident Excel skills. Any exposure to SQL, Python or R is a bonus.
• Meticulousness. In this work, the detail that seems irrelevant is often the one that matters.
• A discreet and professional manner — you will handle sensitive information from your first week.
• Fluent German and English, both written and spoken.

What We Offer

• A structured onboarding programme and a mentor from your first day.
• Early exposure to real investigations rather than back-office support work.
• Funding and study leave for professional qualifications — CFE, ACCA, CPA or the Wirtschaftsprüferexamen.
• A clearly defined path to Consultant with transparent criteria.
• Competitive starting salary, hybrid working and 28 days of annual leave.

How to Apply
Please send your CV, together with a brief note on your motivation and your earliest possible start date. Certificates and references are welcome but not required at first contact.

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to respond within ten working days. All enquiries are treated in strict confidence — we are aware that candidates in this field often apply while in a sensitive current role.

About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.

BRG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our hiring practices provide equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender, national origin, age, United States military veteran status, ancestry, sexual orientation, marital status, family structure, medical condition including genetic characteristics or information, veteran status, or mental or physical disability so long as the essential functions of the job can be performed with or without reasonable accommodation, or any other protected category under federal, state, or local law.

drawn.title: Analyst, Asset Management Real Estate
drawn.body:
About Galvanize

Galvanize is a global asset manager investing at the intersection of energy innovation, resilience, and intelligence. The firm deploys capital across seed, venture, growth, public equities, credit, and real estate, combining investment expertise with deep in-house capabilities in technology, policy, and markets. Galvanize is structured to rapidly identify and execute on investment opportunities created by the energy transition, across all sectors of the economy

Role

Galvanize Real Estate (“GRE”) is seeking an Analyst to join its growing Asset Management team. The Analyst will support all aspects of property ownership, including leasing, financial oversight, property management oversight, capital projects, risk management, sustainability, and reporting. The role will also contribute to the development of GRE’s Asset Management platform as the strategy scales.

Working closely with senior leadership, property managers, and external service providers, the Analyst will help execute investment business plans that integrate financial and sustainability objectives. A key focus will be supporting sustainability initiatives and capital projects that drive investment performance and advance GRE’s key performance indicators.

The Analyst will help prepare materials for regular business plan and portfolio reviews in collaboration with the Portfolio Management team, support asset acquisition and dispositions, and contribute to marketing materials and investor presentations. The role will also assume ownership of select Asset Management workstreams and tools, including those supporting valuations and cash management.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate intellectual curiosity and honesty, actively seek diverse perspectives, and approach decisions through rigorous, fact-based analysis. GRE values a collaborative, consensus-driven culture and strives to support and elevate colleagues through radical transparency, mutual respect, and teamwork.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the business plans, budgets, forecasts, leases, analysis, and approvals
  • Working in a collaborative fashion with third-party property managers, lease administrators, leasing agents, legal counsel, auditors, and accountants
  • Work to implement the business plan, including capital improvements and services to the asset
  • Develop and distribute periodic asset management reports to investors, consultants, and other partners
  • Develop dynamic financial models for a wide variety of performance and investment analyses
  • Track lender mandated reporting and covenants such as debt service ratio coverages
  • Assist the team in the annual budget process and any quarterly forecasts required
  • Analyze weekly and monthly operating reports from property managers and cascade to senior leaders as necessary to identify trends and potentially adjust business plan accordingly
  • Collaborate with other members of the team, including the Sustainability and Science and Tech teams, to achieve overall objectives, including the successful implementation of the sustainability framework across the portfolio to achieve KPIs
  • Assist the Acquisitions team to develop asset business plans and underwritings and help perform market and asset due diligence
  • Ensure adherence to policies and procedures to maintain effective internal controls and compliance
  • Assist in operational takeovers and property manager transition
  • Build and refine financial models used for evaluating current and projected performance of GRE investments
  • Monitoring and tracking transaction data, capital markets and other relevant industry research
  • Participating in the research, analysis, and execution of strategic initiatives
  • Digest market intelligence and cascade to the broader group with the goal of constantly challenging and refining the investment thesis

Required Qualifications and Competencies

  • 1-3 years of commercial real estate experience in an investment, valuation and/or asset management capacity across multiple sectors with a preference for Industrial and Multifamily
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel
  • Proficiency with Argus is a plus, but not required
  • Sophisticated financial skills and capital markets perspective
  • Knowledgeable in finance with a deep understand of real estate budgets
  • Strong analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail, consistently delivering accurate, thorough work on time.
  • Excellent interpersonal and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build relationships across the firm and work effectively with senior management.
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities and results, welcomes constructive feedback, and demonstrates professionalism and integrity.
  • Intellectually curious and proactive, with a track record of anticipating needs and taking initiative beyond assigned responsibilities.
  • Adaptable and comfortable navigating evolving priorities and organizational change.
  • Willing and able to travel.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Estimated base salary, depending on experience: $100,000 - $125,000 per annum
  • Role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus

We invest in our team members’ health, well-being, financial security, and professional growth. Our benefits include:

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible family members
  • A 401(k) match of up to 3%, with immediate vesting
  • 25 days of paid time off, 13 company holidays, and two flexible holidays
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for parents of any gender
  • A $100 monthly wellness reimbursement and access to a range of physical, mental-health, and family-forming resources
  • Up to $5,000 annually for eligible professional development
  • Commuter, home-internet, and travel-program reimbursements for eligible employees

Benefits and eligibility are subject to applicable plan terms and company policies.

drawn.body:
WE ARE:

At Adaptive, we are a financial consulting firm that partners with capital, commodity, and digital market participants. We value differentiation through technology. Our experienced teams design and deliver complex front-office technology solutions using our proven accelerators to create long-term competitive advantage.

Our clients include the world’s leading investment banks, investment managers, fintechs and capital market service providers. With a global reach with offices in London, New York, Barcelona , Manila and Montreal, we have a proven track record delivering powerful, elegant and intuitive trading technology solutions.

We are expanding our product capability and looking for talented individuals to help build transformational capital markets products including:

  • Aeron - our flagship high-performance messaging infrastructure.
  • Hydra - our developer framework for accelerating the development and delivery of trading systems.
  • Artio - our market-leading open-source FIX engine.
  • Aeron Sequencer - replicated state machines at scale.

YOU ARE:

  • A great team player who loves sharing knowledge and learning from others
  • A problem solver with strong analytical skills
  • Excited about learning new things and keeping up to date
  • Happy to work in a test-driven and Agile development fashion

YOU HAVE:

  • Experience in Java server-side software development
  • Experience designing, building, debugging, and operating distributed systems
  • Experience designing and evolving messaging protocols
  • Experience designing and evolving software libraries
  • Experience applying various forms of testing to underpin software qualities, e.g., correctness and performance
  • Experience in measuring, benchmarking and profiling components and systems
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

YOU WILL:

  • Design and develop Java applications and libraries.
  • Write clean, efficient and well-documented code.
  • Troubleshoot and debug Java applications to ensure smooth performance.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and reusability.
  • Keep up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in Java development.
  • Pair with other team members to ensure high-quality outcomes.

WHY US:

  • To be immersed in high-standard engineering culture. Our fantastic team takes pride in crafting complex technical solutions but also loves sharing their knowledge and helping you grow professionally (we have extraordinary minds at Adaptive) You can learn from anyone here, which is the beauty of it.
  • To take part in the growth and development of a great company.
  • Our teams feel free to speak up, make suggestions and raise concerns.
  • Collaborative team environment: we all work together, respect each other, and pitch in.
  • Great consideration for work/life balance (highly-flexible, hybrid working model, well-being benefits…). Balance between professional and personal life is massively important to us.
  • We work hard to provide a positive, collaborative and inclusive culture and to positively impact our staff and local communities through different well-being, diversity and inclusion programmes.

WHAT PEOPLE THINK OF US 🗣️

You can check our Glassdoor page :)

BENEFITS

We create benefits with YOU in mind.

  • 25 days vacation + 2 additional days off for volunteering activities
  • Pension plan
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Ticket restaurant
  • Childcare/Commuting benefits
  • Wellbeing allowance
  • Language classes (English and Spanish)

THE PROCESS

Long interview processes are stressful and boring and that is not us.

We want to make sure that everything runs smoothly.

So here you will have three stage interviews:


1- A chat with one of our great recruiters.
2- A zoom chat with one of our Java colleagues where they will ask you detailed questions about Java knowledge and your experience.
3- A Face to Face interview (either in our office or via Zoom). ​​During this interview, we will dig even deeper, and you will have a technical task to do. You will also have a chat with our local director.


A little tip for you during those stages:

Collaboration is massively important to us, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts, ask questions, ask for help if needed, etc :)

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION:

Diversity and inclusion are key to a great workplace, and Adaptive is better when it’s more representative of the world around us. We want everyone to feel comfortable bringing their whole selves to work without any fear of judgment or negativity.

All we ask is that our colleagues are respectful, collaborative, passionate about what they do, and have the skills needed to be successful in their roles.

Our client relationships are built on trust and discretion. As the world’s largest advisory-focused firm, we have exceptional depth of expertise across industry sectors and geographies. We value the rich diversity that comes from blending local perspective with our global network. Lazard is seeking an Analyst with relevant full time experience to join the Technology team in San Francisco as an integral member of a focused group who will receive meaningful exposure to both senior bankers and client executives alike. Technology Analysts work on a variety of strategic transactions for leading and emerging companies spanning the following verticals: Software, Internet, Hardware and Semiconductors. Lazard is differentiated among the leading investment banks in our history of investing in employees and developing them into successful senior bankers. Apply! We’ll get in touch on the next steps. What we offer: We strive to enhance the total health and well-being of our employees through comprehensive, competitive benefits. Our goal is to offer a highly individualized employee experience that enables you to balance your commitments to career, family, and community. When you work for Lazard, you are working for an organization that cares about your unique talents and passions, and will continue to invest in the development of your career. We expect the base salary range for this role to be approximately $120,000 - $125,000 USD. Various factors contribute to determining the actual base compensation offered, including but not limited to the applicant’s years of relevant experience, career tenure, qualifications, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, relevant skills for the role. Base salary is one component of Lazard Financial Advisory’s compensation package, which also includes comprehensive benefits and may include incentive compensation. Representation at Lazard Lazard is an intellectual capital business committed to delivering the best advice and solutions to clients. To achieve these objectives, we focus on attracting, developing and retaining the best talent. We believe that a workforce comprised of people who represent a wide array of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives creates a rich variety of thought that empowers us to challenge conventional wisdom, solve problems creatively and make better decisions. Lazard was built on the premise that a multicultural firm can best serve a global clientele. As a global firm that has grown organically from local roots in different countries, we have a deep tradition of respecting and appreciating individual differences. Doing so has been core to our success for over 175 years. We are committed to sustaining an environment where every colleague is supported in their professional pursuits, can maximize their individual potential and contribute to our collective success. #LI-EF1

drawn.title: Founding Account Executive
drawn.body:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As the first Account Executive at an early-stage AI software company, you will build the sales motion from the ground up. You will own the revenue process from outbound pipeline generation through closing, partnering directly with the founder to create a repeatable approach.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Generate pipeline through outbound prospecting and cold outreach, without dedicated SDR support.

- Identify and engage relevant prospects, then lead substantive sales conversations.

- Own the full sales cycle, from discovery and negotiation through contract signature.

- Work with the founder to define the ideal customer profile, sales messaging, and playbook.

- Close revenue and establish a foundation for a scalable sales process.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year of sales experience, including prior Account Executive experience.

- Experience generating and managing outbound pipeline and closing deals independently from first contact through signature.

- Background in B2B SaaS sales, with accountability for revenue targets.

- Experience developing sales messaging or value propositions and identifying target customer segments.

- Comfort working in an early-stage, ambiguous environment and building processes from scratch.

- Experience selling to technical or product-focused buyers, or familiarity with AI, machine learning, or developer tools, is beneficial.

- Strong ownership, self-motivation, and accountability for sales outcomes.

- US work authorization is required.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $80,000 to $120,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, United States. The schedule is six working days per week.

drawn.title: Junior IT Systems Administrator
drawn.body:
Aksia Overview

Aksia is an alternative assets specialist, providing investment solutions for institutional investors globally. We provide investment management, advisory and research services across hedge funds, private credit, private equity, real assets, and real estate. As of June 30, 2026, Aksia advises on over $353bn and manages $38bn of client capital.

Position Overview

Aksia is seeking a Junior IT Systems Administrator to join our Information Technology team in Athens. This is a hands-on opportunity for an IT professional who enjoys helping users, troubleshooting technology issues and learning how enterprise IT environments are managed.

The initial focus of the role will be day-to-day IT support for our Athens office, including ticket management, end-user support, hardware troubleshooting and equipment setup. As you develop your skills and demonstrate the ability to take on additional responsibility, you will have the opportunity to contribute to broader systems and infrastructure projects alongside more experienced members of the IT team.

Responsibilities

  • End-User Support: Provide first-line technical support to employees, assisting them with hardware and software issues, network connectivity problems, and general IT inquiries.
  • Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve technical problems related to desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment, both onsite and remotely.
  • System Maintenance: Assist in routine maintenance tasks, including software updates, system patches, and antivirus scans, to ensure optimal performance and security of systems.
  • User Account Management: Administer user accounts and access permissions, creating and modifying accounts as per organizational requirements.
  • Hardware and Software Installation: Assist in the deployment and set up of new hardware and software for employees, ensuring compatibility and proper functioning.
  • Asset Management: Maintain accurate records of IT assets, including hardware and software inventory, and assist in procurement activities.
  • Network Support: Assist in troubleshooting network-related issues, including connectivity problems, Wi-Fi configurations, and LAN setups.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain documentation for IT processes, procedures, and issue resolutions to improve overall efficiency and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of experience in IT as general support or junior systems administration
  • Practical experience supporting Windows 11 users troubleshooting common issues
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and basic concepts relating to user accounts, permissions and endpoint management
  • Exposure to Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi and connectivity troubleshooting
  • Experience using any ticketing or service desk system
  • Strong troubleshooting, organization and prioritization skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high standards of data quality.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
  • Collaborative approach, with the ability to communicate and work effectively across different teams and departments
  • Familiarity with PowerShell is a plus

drawn.title: Vendor Safety Agent, Part-Time
drawn.body:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you’ve been searching for!

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently looking to hire a Part-Time Vendor Safety Agent to join our team embedded with our client in Miami, FL!

*This is a part-time position consisting of 12-hour shifts and the possibility of weekend shifts. Hours may vary based on the site construction schedule.

JOB DESCRIPTION
The Vendor Safety Agent supports on-site safety operations during active construction by controlling vendor access, monitoring personnel movement, and maintaining accountability of individuals, equipment, and materials on the property. This role is responsible for checking construction personnel in and out using a designated access management system, issuing temporary ID badges, and ensuring only authorized vendors are present on site.

The Vendor Safety Agent escorts vendors as required, enforces site safety procedures, and helps protect facilities and restricted areas throughout the construction phase. The position works closely with facilities, construction management, and other teams to maintain a safe work environment and respond to access issues or incidents as they arise. Accurate documentation, attention to detail, and consistent presence on site are critical to success in this role.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Verify construction vendors have approved access, required documentation, and signed NDAs prior to entry
  • Check construction personnel in and out using the Envoy application on a dedicated iPad
  • Print and issue temporary barcode ID badges as part of the check-in process
  • Monitor and control vendor entry and exit points during construction activities
  • Escort vendors and contractors while on site and enforce safety rules
  • Maintain accountability of vendor personnel, tools, equipment, and materials on site
  • Protect property, facilities, and restricted or sensitive areas during active construction
  • Document vendor activity, equipment movement, and safety incidents accurately
  • Respond to and escalate unauthorized access, policy violations, or safety incidents

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of residential, estate, or protective security/safety experience.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • Familiarity with cameras, alarms, access control, and smart-home systems.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to pass a background check.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Military or police experience

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • 401k
  • Paid Sick Leave accrual
Miami, Florida Pay Range
$32—$38 USD

Concentric and SPS Global are committed to programs and initiatives that promote diversity, equity, and inclusion, enhancing our organization and the broader community. We are creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Concentric Advisors and SPS Global are committed to protecting the privacy and security of all applicants who submit personal information to us. You can access our GDPR and CCPA policy by clicking the GDPR button at the bottom of our career page.

drawn.body:
Sales Development Representative

Location: Kansas City, MO (In-Office)

Schedule: Full-time, in-office

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

The Role

We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to fuel Numa's growth by identifying and creating new business opportunities. In this role, you will research potential customers, initiate first contact with dealership decision-makers, qualify interest, and set high-quality meetings for our sales team.

This is a foundational sales role for someone early in their career who wants to build a strong footing in tech and automotive SaaS. You'll be the first point of contact for many prospective customers, so your ability to open conversations, ask good questions, and represent Numa well will directly shape our pipeline.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter who is energized by outreach, resilient in the face of rejection, and driven by hitting activity and meeting targets. You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, in-office environment and want a clear path toward a full-cycle sales career.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and research potential customers through various channels
  • Initiate contact with prospects via phone, email, and social media
  • Qualify leads and schedule meetings for the sales team
  • Meet or exceed daily and weekly activity and meeting targets
  • Maintain accurate records of interactions and pipeline activity in the CRM
  • Collaborate with sales and marketing to develop and refine lead generation strategies
  • Stay informed on automotive industry trends and the competitive landscape

What You Bring

  • Prior experience in a sales, customer service, or other customer-facing role
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficiency with CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • High level of motivation and a results-driven approach
  • Willingness to work full-time in our Kansas City office

Nice To Have

  • Experience in a high-volume outbound prospecting or SDR role
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce
  • Experience selling or supporting SaaS solutions
  • Interest in the automotive industry or dealership operations
  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth technology company

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meet or exceed activity and qualified-meeting targets
  • Build a healthy top-of-funnel pipeline through proactive outreach
  • Deliver a strong first impression that positions Numa well with prospects
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date CRM records
  • Develop the skills and habits needed to grow into a full-cycle sales role

drawn.title: Strategic Growth Manager (Account Executive)
drawn.body:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.

Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.

AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

- Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

- Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

- Great Place to Work Certified™

The Role:

The Strategic Growth team is responsible for bringing top-producing financial advisors to Savvy and plays a critical role in the company’s continued growth.

In this role you will partner closely with our SDR team, who provide top-of-funnel support by identifying and engaging prospective advisors. From there, you will own the sales process --building relationships with advisors and helping them understand how Savvy’s technology, marketing, operational support, and culture can enable them to build a stronger, more scalable wealth management business.

This is a highly consultative sale centered on influencing successful advisors to make a meaningful career and business transition. You’ll work directly with the decision-makers themselves, allowing you to build genuine relationships, navigate complex considerations, and make a visible impact on Savvy’s growth.

Responsibilities:

- Bring top producing financial advisors with an existing book of business to Savvy by effectively selling the Savvy value proposition.

- Partner with the SDR team to engage prospective financial advisors, inbound and outbound, and qualify them to ensure they're a strong fit. Build relationships with prospects as a business partner and help them understand the different paths to achieving their business goals.

- Identify the key pain points a prospective financial advisor has and tailor the sales process accordingly.

- Prepare for and run the recruiting process to showcase Savvy's technology platform, sales and marketing capabilities, and operational support to prospective financial advisors.

- Understand a prospective advisor's pricing and compensation expectations and book-of-business transferability, and use that information to customize pricing and compensation contracts that work for both the advisor and Savvy.

- Leverage internal tools and keep them up to date based on your sales activity.

- Prepare for and participate in regular business reviews with the Leadership Team, sharing pipeline data, learnings, and next steps, and providing forecasts across your current pipeline and projections for future quarters.

Nuances for this role:

- This is a quota-carrying role. Deal size ranges from $200K to $1M+ ARR, with an average time to close currently under two months.

- This is a more humanized sale than the average technology sales process, since you're dealing directly with decision-makers. Think of every financial advisor as the CEO of their own business, this requires a heightened degree of empathy to be successful, along with the ability to make quick decisions.

- Consider a top producing financial advisor who's been with a firm for 10+ years. Their personal and professional identity is often tied to that firm's brand. Successfully educating an advisor and facilitating a move from their prior firm takes outstanding patience, listening, agility, and focus to get the deal done.

- The equally demanding need for high IQ and high EQ in this role has built an incredibly high-performing, driven team with diverse backgrounds.

Must have:

- 5+ years of relevant sales experience in quota-carrying roles

- Experience with deal sizes of $150K to $1M ARR

- Experience working with deal cycles ranging from 1–12 months

- Experience selling to senior executives and owners

- Proficiency with revenue-related technology, such as AI (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and sales and marketing tools (e.g., LInkedIn, Outreach, Gong, etc.)

Nice to have:

- Experience recruiting individuals through a tech-enabled platform business, a staffing agency, or as a corporate recruiter

- Experience selling in the financial advisory / wealth management space (RIA, broker-dealer, bank)

- 2+ years of experience at a high-growth tech startup

BENEFITS:

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

- Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

- Company 401(k), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans

- NYC office in the heart of Manhattan

- Lunch and snacks provided in the office

- Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

- Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

Adhere to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 1+ year of sales experience in Retail Banking, Financial Services, or other related industries with proven success in establishing new clients, deepening relationships, and delivering results. Ability to create memorable experiences for our clients – elevate the client experience. Excellent communication skills, both in person and over the phone, with proven ability to tailor features and benefits of products and services to clients with differing needs. Ability to quickly and effectively resolve client issues with attention to detail – providing consistent client experience. Operate within established risk parameters/tolerances and meet internal/external risk and compliance obligations, including completion of required training. High school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent. The Securities Industry Essential (SIE) exam, FINRA Series 6, state registration (including 63 if required), and Life licenses are minimum requirements. All unlicensed applicants must obtain their licenses through JPMC’s licensing program within 180 days of hire, study materials and support provided. Ability to work branch hours including weekends and some evenings. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills College degree or military equivalent. Experience adhering to banking policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act This position is subject to the Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act qualification requirements for Loan Originators. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMC's review of your criminal conviction history, credit report, information available through NMLS, and any other information relevant to a determination by JPMC that you demonstrate financial responsibility, good character, and general fitness for the position. Note that any felony conviction within the last seven years will disqualify you from consideration for this position. Your continued employment in this position would be contingent upon compliance with Truth in Lending Act/Dodd Frank Loan Originator requirements. In addition, this position requires National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the SAFE Act of 2008. As such, upon active employment with JPMorganChase, you will be required to either register on NMLS, or to update your existing registration as necessary to grant access to and reflect your employment with JPMorganChase. Your continued employment in this position with JPMorganChase is contingent upon compliance with the SAFE Act, including successful registration immediately after your start date, and timely completion of annual renewal and required updates thereafter. Any information obtained during the registration, update, and renewal processes or through NMLS notifications may impact your employment with the firm. Any of the completed information you provide during the Chase on-line application process may be transferred, on your behalf, to NMLS by JPMorganChase. Please carefully review the information you provide to Chase for accuracy and consistency and with any current NMLS record, if applicable, before submitting. Further information about NMLS and registration requirements of registration can be found at: http://mortgage.nationwidelicensingsystem.org/SAFE/Pages/default Deliver exceptional client experience as a Relationship Banker, embodying our commitment to hospitality and client care.

drawn.title: Registered Client Service Associate-Greenville, SC
drawn.body:
Job Description Summary
Supports Financial advisors and their prospective and existing clients and other branch staff team members. Demonstrates effective communication skills across multiple platforms (phone, email, in-person, virtual), as well as the ability to organize, manage, and track multiple, detailed tasks and assignments with frequently changing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, task-oriented work environment.

Job Description
Job SummaryCelebrating more than 60 years of rich history and recognition for service and excellence in the Financial Services industry, Raymond James is seeking a dynamic Registered Client Service Associate who is a motivated, detail oriented and creative problem solver to join our growing team. This essential role helps to provide high quality/high touch critical administrative support to Financial Advisors, their prospective and existing clients and other branch staff team members. The ideal candidate will have effective communication skills across multiple platforms (phone, email, in-person, virtual), as well as the ability to organize, manage, and track multiple, detailed tasks and assignments with frequently changing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, task-oriented work environment. Come grow with us and see where a career at Raymond James could take you!

Responsibilities:

Serves as first point of contact to service a high volume of daily interactions, including basic inquiries, providing quotes and scheduling of meetings, with prospective and existing clients on the phone, in-person, virtually and through mailings.

Works both independently and within a dynamic team environment to provide crucial support to the financial advisors and branch office.

Onboards new clients, opens new client accounts and researches client and security information using internal databases and other technologies.

Ensures key client information and documentation is current with firm and industry requirements, rules and regulations.

Processes and monitors the transfer of assets to ensure all assets and cost basis were successfully received.

Monitors available cash awaiting investment, including running weekly cash and cash equivalent reports and contacting clients with investment opportunities to maximize returns.

Reviews, assesses and responds to all corporate action items and client account alerts.

Prepares financial reports, spreadsheets and other materials for client meetings.

Inputs orders and rebalances portfolios on behalf of the Financial Advisors.

Creates and maintains records and files utilizing Client Relationship Management (CRM) software.

Assists Financial Advisors with marketing efforts including seminars and other client-facing events.

Actively engages in available training/cross-training and educational and/or professional development opportunities to remain current on firm and industry policies and procedures.

Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Skills:

Company’s working structure, policies, mission, and strategies.

Managed account platforms.

General office practices, procedures, and methods.

Investment concepts, practices and procedures used in the securities industry.

Financial markets, products and industry regulations.

Trading terminology.

Client Relationship Management (CRM) software, or similar contact management software.

Goal planning software.

Excel, including developing spreadsheets as needed and for ongoing reporting.

Effective communication across multiple client interactive platforms (in-person, virtual, phone and mail)

Operate standard office equipment and using required software applications to produce correspondence, reports, electronic communication, spreadsheets, and databases.

Analyze and research account information.

Organize, manage, and track multiple, detailed tasks and assignments with. frequently changing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, task-oriented work environment.

Identify time sensitive items and assess competing priorities.

Take initiative and proactively follow up on submitted items to ensure completion; resolve errors, questions or concerns.

Handle stressful situations and provide a high level of customer service in a calm and professional manner.

Analyze problems and establish solutions in a fast paced environment.

Use mathematics sufficient to process account and transaction information.

Use appropriate interpersonal styles and communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with all organizational levels, in person and virtually.

Work both independently and as part of a cohesive team.

Provide a high level of customer service.

Education/Previous Experience

High School Diploma or equivalent and one (1) or more years securities industry or related work experience preferred, or an equivalent combination of experience, education, and/or training as approved by Human Resources.

Licenses/Certifications

SIE required provided that an exemption or grandfathering cannot be applied.

Series 7 required.

Series 63, 65 and/or 66 as required by state.

Education
High School (HS) (Required)

Work Experience
General Experience - 6 to 10 years

Certifications
AG - Agent - Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), GS - Gen Sec Rep - Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), RA - Investment Adv Rep - Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), Securities Industry Essentials Exam (SIE) - Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)

Travel
Less than 25%

Workstyle
Resident

The total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. This position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave. Eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. To view more details of the benefits offered, visit Myrjbenefits.com.

At Raymond James our associates use five guiding behaviors (Develop, Collaborate, Decide, Deliver, Improve) to deliver on the firm's core values of client-first, integrity, independence and a conservative, long-term view.

We expect our associates at all levels to:
• Grow professionally and inspire others to do the same
• Work with and through others to achieve desired outcomes
• Make prompt, pragmatic choices and act with the client in mind
• Take ownership and hold themselves and others accountable for delivering results that matter
• Contribute to the continuous evolution of the firm

At Raymond James – as part of our people-first culture, we honor, value, and respect the uniqueness, experiences, and backgrounds of all of our Associates. When associates bring their best authentic selves, our organization, clients, and communities thrive. The Company is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs.

drawn.title: IT Systems Engineer
drawn.body: <div class="content-intro"><p>Breakthrough Properties is a life science real estate investment company that leverages cross-sector collaboration to deliver environments that foster innovation and scientific breakthroughs. As a joint- venture between Tishman Speyer and Bellco Capital, combining Tishman Speyer’s global real estate platform with Bellco Capital’s deep life science investment expertise, Breakthrough is developing and delivering environments where companies can create life-changing therapies for patients. Breakthrough is led by an experienced management team with a proven track record investing, developing and operating best-in- class life science real estate. At Breakthrough, we seek to be a home for scientific discovery and innovation because we understand what scientists do, how they do it and why they do it.</p></div><p>We are seeking a technically skilled and service-oriented <strong>IT Systems Engineer</strong> to serve as the primary on-site IT resource for our Boston-area life science portfolio. This role owns regional helpdesk operations and systems administration while also providing remote IT support across BTP's full portfolio of corporate offices and properties in the US and UK.</p> <p>The position is the first point of escalation for end users across the Northeast region and is directly involved in tenant technology support, move-in coordination, vendor management, and on-site infrastructure operations. You will work closely with the Senior Director of IT and align with the San Diego-based IT Manager, operating with a high degree of autonomy while maintaining consistent standards across all BTP properties.&nbsp;This is a high-ownership role for someone who operates well independently, communicates proactively, and wants to be part of a growing organization where their contributions are visible and valued.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Regional &amp; On-Site Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary on-site IT resource for Boston-area BTP properties, providing Tier 3 helpdesk support for regional staff and tenants</li> <li>Coordinate and execute tenant technology move-ins including network provisioning, AV setup, access control onboarding, and infrastructure readiness for new tenant spaces</li> <li>Manage on-site vendor relationships for IT-related services including cabling, low-voltage, AV, and physical infrastructure projects</li> <li>Conduct site assessments and coordinate IT infrastructure work tied to tenant improvements, buildouts, and property transitions</li> <li>Support meeting room technology, video conferencing systems, and shared AV infrastructure across Boston properties</li> <li>Provide occasional travel support to other Northeast and regional BTP properties as operational needs arise</li> </ul> <p><strong>Remote Portfolio Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide remote Tier 3 helpdesk support across BTP's full portfolio of US and UK properties, serving as a shared resource for corporate staff and distributed teams</li> <li>Collaborate with IT leadership and the San Diego-based IT Manager to maintain consistent systems, standards, and processes across all portfolio assets</li> <li>Support remote troubleshooting, device management, and user administration for staff outside the Boston region</li> <li>Assist in the coordination of IT needs for new property openings, expansions, and portfolio-wide initiatives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Helpdesk &amp; End User Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and manage the regional helpdesk queue through Freshservice, ensuring SLA adherence, thorough documentation, and quality ticket closure</li> <li>Identify recurring issues and drive root-cause resolutions to reduce ticket volume and improve end-user self-sufficiency over time</li> <li>Onboard and offboard employees - provisioning accounts, devices, and access in coordination with automated IT workflows</li> <li>Provide hands-on and remote support for hardware, software, peripherals, and mobile devices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Administration &amp; Infrastructure</strong></p> <ul> <li>Administer and maintain the endpoint fleet using Microsoft Intune and NinjaOne RMM - patch management, policy enforcement, software deployment, and compliance reporting</li> <li>Manage IT asset lifecycle - procurement, inventory tracking, device deployment, and recovery</li> <li>Support Entra ID (Azure AD) administration including user and group management, conditional access policies, and identity governance</li> <li>Maintain and troubleshoot Cisco Meraki network infrastructure across Boston properties - switches, wireless APs, and MX security appliances</li> <li>Administer physical access control - credential management, group assignments, and access audits</li> <li>Support the Microsoft 365 environment including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and licensing</li> <li>Administer Box for end users, including permissions, folder structure, and M365 integration</li> <li>Contribute to Azure-based workloads and automation initiatives under direction from the Senior Director of IT</li> <li>Maintain IT documentation in the knowledge base and contribute to runbooks and standard operating procedures</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security &amp; Compliance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) monitoring and alert triage for the Boston region</li> <li>Enforce endpoint compliance and security baselines across managed devices</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI &amp; Automation</strong></p> <p>Breakthrough Properties is building an automation-first IT operation, and this role is expected to actively contribute to that effort. The ideal candidate is not just a consumer of AI tools but a practitioner — someone who sees repetitive processes as opportunities and reaches for automation before accepting manual work as the norm.</p> <p><strong>Process Automation &amp; Tooling</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and implement automation opportunities across IT operations — including onboarding/offboarding workflows, endpoint provisioning, alerting, and routine administrative tasks</li> <li>Build and maintain integrations using Workato or comparable iPaaS platforms to connect BTP's core systems (M365, Freshservice, Entra ID, Box, NinjaOne, and others)</li> <li>Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and lightweight internal tools to extend and automate IT processes</li> <li>Contribute to BTP's agentic IT workflows — supporting AI-assisted orchestration across ticketing, identity management, and infrastructure monitoring</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Tool Fluency</strong></p> <ul> <li>Apply AI-assisted tools (including Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and similar platforms) to accelerate IT tasks — documentation, troubleshooting research, script generation, and communications</li> <li>Stay current on emerging AI capabilities relevant to IT operations and evaluate new tooling for practical application within BTP's environment</li> <li>Contribute to the development of internal AI use cases and help establish repeatable, governed patterns for AI adoption across the IT team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Documentation &amp; Knowledge Automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use AI-assisted workflows to generate, maintain, and improve runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles</li> <li>Identify opportunities to reduce ticket volume through automated self-service, intelligent routing, and proactive monitoring</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>5-7 years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or a combined helpdesk/sysadmin role</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration</li> <li>Proficiency with endpoint management tools - Intune, NinjaOne, or equivalent RMM/MDM platforms</li> <li>Working knowledge of networking fundamentals - VLANs, DNS, DHCP, switching, and wireless</li> <li>Experience supporting Windows 11 endpoints in an enterprise environment</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage competing priorities without day-to-day supervision</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills - comfortable with both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>Experience coordinating with vendors, contractors, or third-party service providers</li> <li>Foundational experience with scripting or automation - PowerShell, Python, or workflow tools such as Power Automate, Workato, or equivalent</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Cisco Meraki network administration</li> <li>Familiarity with Avigilon or comparable physical access control platforms</li> <li>Experience with Freshservice or similar ITSM ticketing systems</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Workato, Power Automate, or comparable iPaaS/automation platforms</li> <li>Exposure to Azure infrastructure, Logic Apps, or Azure Automation</li> <li>Experience building or contributing to AI-assisted workflows or internal tooling</li> <li>Experience supporting tenant move-ins, AV deployments, or technology infrastructure projects in a commercial real estate environment</li> <li>Microsoft certifications a plus</li> <li>Experience in a multi-site or distributed organization supporting remote and in-person users</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Environment</strong></p> <ul> <li>On-site, Boston-based role — regular in-office presence required at primary Boston property</li> <li>Occasional travel to other Northeast and regional BTP properties</li> <li>Remote support responsibilities for BTP's full US and UK portfolio</li> <li>Lean, high-trust team with direct access to IT leadership and real ownership from day one</li> </ul> <hr> <p>The base compensation range for this role is $105,000-$120,000 annually. This role is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, as well as our comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, 401(k) plan (with matching contributions), wellness benefits and all other benefits afforded to full-time Breakthrough employees.</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement</strong><br>As an equal opportunity employer, Breakthrough Properties is committed to a diverse workforce. Employment decisions regarding recruitment and selection will be made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non-job-related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state, and local laws.</p> <p><strong>All Applicants:</strong><br>Knows Your Rights Notice:&nbsp;<a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/poster">https://www.eeoc.gov/poster</a><br>Employee Polygraph Protection: <a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/employee-polygraph-protection-act">https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/employee-polygraph-protection-act</a></p> <p><strong>California Applicants:&nbsp;<br></strong>We are committed to fair chance hiring practices. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act.<br>We do not inquire about criminal history until after a conditional offer of employment has been made.</p> <p><strong>Massachusetts Applicants:&nbsp;<br></strong>It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

drawn.body: Part-time Client Service Associate - NR Location US-MN-Mankato ID 2026-10020 Category Branch Office Support Position Type Regular | Part Time Work Type Onsite Why Stifel Stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole. Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success . What You'll Be Doing The Client Services Associate (NR) assists one or more Financial Advisor(s) (FA(s)) with the opening and maintenance of client accounts and records, performs a wide variety of administrative support duties, including but not limited to, word processing, preparing mailings, filing, answering the phone, obtaining approvals for FA(s) communications and advertisements, provides overall customer service support to clients, may enter trades as directed by the FA(s). What We're Looking For Perform clerical functions related to opening client accounts and ongoing account coding based on account features chosen by the client. Work with the FA(s) and the client in obtaining the required documents based upon the type of account(s) established. Organize and assist in the maintenance of complete client account and trade- related records for the FA(s) and certain required files for the branch office. Perform operational or administrative functions for client related requests (i.e., check requests, wiring funds, address change, dividend information, etc.). Upon request, provide quotes and other account-related information to assist clients; non-registered Client Service Associates may not volunteer quote or other stock information to clients. Provide reports and other information to FA(s), as requested. Identify situations that need to be brought to the attention of the FA(s) or escalated to the Branch Manager; including suspicious client and/or employee activity or behavior. Perform various administrative duties (i.e., typing, filing, answer phones, mailing documents/letters, etc.) and other duties and projects as assigned by the FA and/or Branch Manager. What You'll Bring Administrative Knowledge - Knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and systems such as word processing, spread-sheet applications, managing files and records, and other office procedures and terminology. Industry Knowledge - General understanding of the investment brokerage industry and securities regulations with basic knowledge of investment products. Time Management - Able to organize, prioritize and manage multiple tasks, responsibilities and deadlines; is able to follow through and accomplish goals, manage expectations appropriately and use firm's resources efficiently. Critical Thinking - Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to practical problem solving. Customer and Interpersonal Skills - Knowledge of principles and processes for providing exemplary customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction. Communication Skills - The ability to communicate information and ideas in spoken or written form so that others will understand with excellent grammar and phone/office etiquette. Education & Experience Minimum Required: High School Diploma or equivalent Minimum Required: 2 years clerical/related industry Licenses & Credentials Minimum Required: None Systems & Technology Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook Compensation Range Salary: - Actual salaries may vary, and may be based on several factors, including but not limited to each candidate’s qualifications, skills, and overall competencies for the position. The base salary is one component of Stifel’s overall compensation package for each individual employee. Other benefits and offerings include, but not limited to, discretionary bonuses, health / dental / vision / prescription insurance offerings, Stifel Total Health Connect, flexible spending accounts, tuition & certification assistance programs, paid time off, and much, much more! To view a more comprehensive list of Stifel’s current offerings, please visit https://www.stifel.com/careers/benefits. Applications are accepted until the position is filled. About Stifel Stifel is more than 130 years old and still thinking like a start-up. We are a global wealth management and investment banking firm serious about innovation and fresh ideas. Built on a simple premise of safeguarding our clients’ money as if it were our own, coined by our namesake, Herman Stifel, our success is intimately tied to our commitment to helping families, companies, and municipalities find their own success. While our headquarters is in St. Louis, we have offices in New York, San Francisco, Baltimore, London, Frankfurt, Toronto, and more than 400 other locations. drawn.title: Assistant Chief Pilot
drawn.body:
About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for an Assistant Chief Pilot to join our Flight Operations team. This role is based onsite in Durham, North Carolina. As our Assistant Chief Pilot, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the future of autonomous aviation. Reporting directly to the Chief Pilot, you will inspire, lead, and empower our Pilot-in-Command (PIC) Managers and sUAS Flight Operators, ensuring operational excellence, mission readiness, and continuous team development across Wing's commercial drone delivery service. If you are an experienced leader with 8+ years of managing-high performing teams in safety-critical environments and are passionate about driving cutting-edge flight operations, we want to hear from you.

Note: This position is subject to Wing’s Drug and Alcohol testing policy in accordance with company procedures and DOT/FAA regulatory requirements. Wing is a Zero Tolerance Drug Free Workplace. All prospective employees in FAA/DOT-regulated roles are subject to pre-employment drug testing. Any applicant applying to a FAA/DOT regulated role who has previously tested positive on any required drug or alcohol test at a former employer will be considered ineligible for employment with Wing.

What You’ll Do:

  • Assist the Chief Pilot in overseeing the safe and compliant daily operation of Wing’s delivery business in the United States, including ongoing commercial delivery operations and demonstrations/tests for regulators and other external stakeholders
  • Work closely with the Chief Pilot to manage PIC operational performance, availability, readiness, and scheduling
  • Work closely with the Chief Pilot to support Policy, Regulatory, Operations, and other teams
  • Maintain qualification for and function as a Part 135 Pilot-in-Command for Wing’s highly autonomous drone delivery service on a regular basis
  • Function as a people manager for a team of 3-5 PIC Managers
  • Enable professional and skill development of the PIC Managers and PICs on your team
  • Assist the Chief Pilot with ensuring the readiness and availability of PIC Stations and Operations Rooms and associated equipment
  • Facilitate onboarding of newly hired crew members
  • Exercise specific delegated operational authority on behalf of the Chief Pilot or Director of Operations, including as a duty Remote Operations Control Center supervisor
  • Directly support Wing’s public and government outreach efforts
  • Maintain strict confidentiality when dealing with sensitive information
  • Travel within the United States (up to 20%) required and sometimes for extended periods

What You’ll Need:

  • 8+ years of experience with commercial/civil or public UAS operations or university-level education and training in civil UAS operations or military equivalent
  • 5+ years of people management experience with 5+ direct reports or more in aviation, transportation, or other safety-critical operations
  • 3+ years of experience as a PIC in Part 135 commercial drone delivery operations or equivalent, and a passion for aviation and the ongoing development of this new industry.
  • Current FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot certificate. If applicable, Part 107 recurrent certificate: only the ALC-677 course is accepted
  • Current driver’s license and clean driving record within the last 36-months
  • Must hold a valid FAA Third Class Medical Certificate (or higher) with an issuance date within the previous 36 months
  • Extensive knowledge and experience working with an aviation regulatory framework
  • A determination to recruit and foster the development of diverse teams
  • Experience with technical or engineering record keeping methods and tools
  • Experience working with web-based monitoring and control systems
  • Ability to communicate clearly in spoken and written English
  • Ability to work a rotating 7-day schedule within crew duty time limits, including weekends and holidays
  • Willingness to travel to complete initial and recurrent training
  • Ability to work independently and in teams while still maintaining rigorous attention to detail
  • Ability to maintain attention to detail for extended periods in a monitoring role
  • Willing to meet Pilot Records Database (PRD) consent requirements

The US base salary range for this full-time position is the salary range below + bonus + equity + benefits. Wing’s salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

Salary Range
$140,000—$148,000 USD

Wing is an equal opportunity employer and it is Wing's policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. Employment at Wing is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Wing does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law.

If you have a need that requires accommodation during the interview process due to a disability or special need, please let us know by completing our Candidate Accommodations Request Form.
